title: Project Manager - Execution (Electrical)
description:
Adani Energy Solutions Limited is looking for an experienced
**Project Manager - Execution (Electrical)**
to support the development and execution of District Cooling System (DCS) projects. The role will be responsible for managing electrical, instrumentation, and control system execution activities across project lifecycles, ensuring quality, safety, timely delivery, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Execution & Engineering**

* Lead execution of electrical, instrumentation, and control system works for District Cooling projects.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, engineering specifications, shop drawings, tender drawings, and construction plans.
* Monitor project execution activities to ensure compliance with approved designs, technical standards, and project requirements.
* Conduct site inspections and oversee contractor performance throughout project execution.
* Ensure project milestones, schedules, budgets, and quality standards are achieved.

**Construction, Testing & Commissioning**

* Review and approve construction methodologies and work procedures.
* Manage testing & commissioning (T&C) activities for electrical and control systems.
* Witness performance testing and ensure systems are commissioned as per design intent.
* Identify construction defects, track corrective actions, and ensure timely closure.
* Support seamless handover from project execution to operations.

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Implement quality assurance processes across all electrical and instrumentation works.
* Ensure adherence to health, safety, environmental, and statutory requirements.
* Drive compliance with engineering standards, industry best practices, and project specifications.
* Maintain a strong safety culture at project sites.

**Planning & Coordination**

* Develop project schedules, implementation plans, milestones, and completion targets.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, contractors, consultants, and stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.
* Support techno-commercial evaluations, bid reviews, and project planning activities.
* Drive technology adoption and digital practices to improve project efficiency.

**Stakeholder & Team Management**

* Collaborate with internal teams including engineering, procurement, techno-commercial, and project management functions.
* Manage relationships with OEMs, consultants, contractors, government authorities, and project stakeholders.
* Facilitate effective communication and coordination among project teams.
* Support team development through mentoring, training identification, and knowledge sharing.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering
* Additional certifications in Project Management will be an advantage

**Experience**

* 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in project execution.
* Hands-on experience in Greenfield and Brownfield infrastructure projects.
* Exposure to Testing & Commissioning (T&C) and operational handover activities.
* Experience in electrical systems execution within MEP, HVAC, Utilities, Infrastructure, Real Estate, Industrial, Data Center, Smart City, or District Cooling projects.

**Preferred Technical Expertise**

* Electrical Systems Execution
* Instrumentation & Controls
* Testing & Commissioning
* Power Distribution Systems
* Building Services Engineering
* MEP Projects
* HVAC Utilities
* Construction Management
* Quality Assurance & Site Inspections
* Contractor & Vendor Management

**Key Skills**

* Project Planning & Scheduling
* Electrical Engineering Design Review
* Site Execution Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Safety & Compliance
* Risk Management
* Problem Solving
* Team Collaboration
* Communication Skills
* Project Delivery

**Why Join Us?**

Be part of AESL's growing District Cooling System business and contribute to the development of sustainable, energy-efficient cooling infrastructure for future-ready cities, industrial zones, commercial developments, and large-scale infrastructure projects.

title: Planning Lead
description:
**Planning Lead - Data Centre Construction**
**JLL Project and Development Services**
**Adani Data Centre Project, Dholera, Gujarat**
**Position Overview**
The Planning Lead will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and controlling comprehensive project schedules for the Adani Data Centre project in Dholera. This critical role requires expertise in planning and scheduling complex, mission-critical facilities with multiple interfaces, fast-track delivery requirements, and stringent milestone commitments. The Planning Lead will serve as the primary schedule management authority, providing strategic insights to support project decision-making and ensure on-time delivery of this landmark data centre facility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Master Schedule Development & Management**
Develop and maintain the integrated master project schedule encompassing all phases from design development through construction, commissioning, and handover. Create detailed Level 3 and Level 4 schedules for all work packages including civil works, structural, MEP systems, data centre infrastructure, façade, interiors, and specialty systems. Establish logical relationships, activity sequencing, and resource loading to accurately reflect project execution strategy and constraints. Define critical path, near-critical activities, and float analysis to identify schedule risks and optimization opportunities. Integrate contractor schedules into the master program ensuring consistency, interface coordination, and alignment with project milestones.
  
  
**Baseline Schedule Management**
Establish baseline schedules for all project phases and major work packages following approval by project leadership and Adani stakeholders. Manage baseline change control processes, documenting approved revisions and maintaining historical records of schedule evolution. Conduct quarterly baseline reviews to assess schedule performance, analyze trends, and recommend corrective actions. Ensure all schedule changes are properly documented with clear justification, impact assessment, and stakeholder approval.
  
  
**Progress Monitoring & Reporting**
Conduct weekly schedule updates based on actual site progress, resource deployment, and milestone achievements verified through site inspections and contractor reports. Prepare comprehensive progress reports including earned value analysis, schedule variance analysis, and critical path updates for internal and client stakeholders. Generate lookahead schedules for 2-week, 4-week, and 3-month horizons to facilitate proactive resource planning and coordination. Prepare monthly executive summaries highlighting schedule performance, key achievements, upcoming milestones, and areas of concern. Develop dashboard presentations showing schedule health metrics, milestone tracking, and performance indicators for steering committee meetings.
  
  
**Critical Path Analysis & Optimization**
Continuously monitor and analyze critical path activities, identifying potential delays and recommending proactive mitigation measures. Conduct "what-if" scenario analysis to evaluate impacts of design changes, weather delays, resource constraints, or scope modifications. Recommend schedule acceleration strategies including fast-tracking opportunities, activity overlapping, resource augmentation, or alternative construction methodologies. Optimize construction sequencing to minimize activity conflicts, reduce downtime, and maximize workforce productivity. Identify opportunities for parallel execution and early commissioning of independent systems.
  
  
**Contractor Schedule Coordination**
Review and approve contractor schedules ensuring they align with master program requirements, interface commitments, and milestone obligations. Facilitate schedule coordination meetings with multiple contractors to resolve interface conflicts, sequence dependencies, and resource allocation issues. Monitor contractor schedule compliance and implement corrective actions when performance deviates from planned progress. Ensure contractor schedules reflect appropriate level of detail, realistic durations, and proper logic ties. Verify that contractor updates accurately represent field conditions and remaining work scope.
  
  
**Data Centre-Specific Planning**
Develop specialized schedules for mission-critical data centre systems including UPS installation, generator commissioning, precision cooling deployment, electrical distribution, raised floor installation, and cable management systems. Coordinate sequencing between base building construction and data centre infrastructure deployment to enable parallel activities and early commissioning. Plan for phased commissioning approach allowing progressive handover of operational zones while construction continues in adjacent areas. Integrate IT equipment installation schedules with construction completion to optimize overall project timeline. Account for long-lead equipment procurement including chillers, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, and cooling units in schedule planning.
  
  
**Commissioning & Handover Planning**
Develop detailed commissioning schedules for all building systems and data centre infrastructure including testing protocols, inspection requirements, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate integrated systems testing sequences ensuring proper dependencies between mechanical, electrical, controls, and fire protection systems. Plan for phased handover strategy allowing early occupation of completed areas while construction continues in other zones. Schedule training sessions, documentation delivery, warranty activation, and operational readiness activities. Develop punch list management schedules tracking defect rectification and final completion activities.
  
  
**Risk Management & Mitigation Planning**
Identify schedule-related risks including design delays, procurement issues, contractor performance, weather impacts, and regulatory approval timelines. Develop schedule risk registers quantifying probability, impact, and mitigation strategies for key risks. Conduct schedule risk analysis using Monte Carlo simulation or similar techniques to establish probabilistic completion forecasts. Recommend schedule contingencies and buffer management strategies to protect critical milestones. Monitor risk trigger events and implement contingency plans when risks materialize.
  
  
**Resource Planning & Leveling**
Develop resource-loaded schedules showing labor, equipment, and material requirements across project phases. Identify resource constraints, bottlenecks, and peak demand periods requiring special attention or augmentation. Coordinate with contractors to ensure adequate resource mobilization aligned with schedule requirements. Perform resource leveling analysis to optimize workforce utilization and minimize inefficiencies. Track resource productivity metrics and adjust schedule assumptions based on actual performance data.
  
  
**Design & Procurement Integration**
Integrate design development schedules with construction planning, ensuring timely information release to support site activities. Track design deliverable schedules, RFI response times, and drawing approval cycles impacting construction progress. Coordinate procurement schedules for long-lead items, critical equipment, and bulk materials with installation requirements. Monitor submittal approval workflows and expedite critical path submittals to prevent construction delays. Develop material delivery schedules coordinating with storage capacity, just-in-time delivery requirements, and construction sequencing.
  
  
**Stakeholder Communication & Coordination**
Chair regular planning meetings with project team, contractors, and consultants to review schedule status, upcoming activities, and coordination requirements. Present schedule performance and forecasts to project leadership, client stakeholders, and executive steering committees. Respond to schedule-related queries from Adani stakeholders, addressing concerns and providing data-driven insights. Facilitate three-week lookahead meetings with trade contractors to coordinate sequencing, access requirements, and resource deployment. Communicate schedule impacts of change requests, variations, and scope modifications to decision-makers.
  
  
**Claims & Delay Analysis**
Document schedule impacts of changes, disruptions, or unforeseen conditions providing factual basis for time extension assessments. Conduct delay analysis using industry-standard methodologies including impacted as-planned, time impact analysis, or windows analysis as appropriate. Prepare time extension submissions with supporting narratives, logic diagrams, and impact quantification. Review contractor delay claims, evaluating validity, concurrent delays, and contractual entitlements. Maintain contemporaneous schedule records to support dispute resolution or arbitration proceedings if required.
  
  
**Tools & Systems Management**
Maintain project scheduling software systems ensuring data integrity, version control, and backup protocols. Establish schedule coding structures including WBS codes, activity codes, and custom fields to enable multi-dimensional analysis and reporting. Develop standardized schedule reports, filters, and layouts for consistent communication across stakeholder groups. Train project team members on schedule reading, progress reporting, and lookahead planning processes. Implement digital planning tools including BIM 4D integration, collaborative platforms, and visual schedule communication tools.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Best Practices**
Capture lessons learned from schedule performance, identifying opportunities for process improvement and efficiency gains. Benchmark schedule performance against industry standards and comparable data centre projects. Implement planning best practices including pull planning, last planner system, or lean construction methodologies where applicable. Stay current with data centre construction trends, modular approaches, and innovative delivery methods impacting schedule optimization.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education & Professional Credentials**
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related technical discipline required. PMP certification, PSP (Planning and Scheduling Professional), or equivalent scheduling credential highly preferred. Advanced training in critical path method scheduling, earned value management, and schedule risk analysis.
  
  
**Experience Requirements**
Minimum 10-12 years of progressive experience in construction planning and scheduling with at least 5 years focused on large-scale, complex projects. Proven track record planning and delivering mission-critical facilities including data centres, hospitals, laboratories, pharmaceutical facilities, or similar critical infrastructure projects valued at INR 300 crores or above. Experience with fast-track construction delivery, phased handovers, and occupied building renovations beneficial. Prior experience working on projects in Gujarat or understanding regional construction practices, contractor capabilities, and site conditions preferred.
  
  
**Data Centre & Technical Knowledge**
Strong understanding of data centre design, construction sequencing, and commissioning requirements for mission-critical facilities. Knowledge of data centre systems including power distribution, cooling infrastructure, raised floors, cable management, and fire suppression systems. Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier requirements, commissioning protocols, and operational readiness considerations. Understanding of MEP systems integration, controls commissioning, and building automation in data centre environments.
  
  
**Software & Technical Skills**
Expert-level proficiency in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project for schedule development, analysis, and reporting. Experience with BIM 4D visualization tools (Navisworks, Synchro) for schedule integration with 3D models. Proficiency in earned value management systems and schedule analytics software. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for schedule data analysis, dashboards, and custom reporting. Familiarity with collaborative planning platforms and cloud-based project management systems.
  
  
**Planning Methodologies**
Deep expertise in critical path method (CPM) scheduling including activity relationships, float calculations, and constraint management. Knowledge of schedule compression techniques including fast-tracking, crashing, and resource optimization. Experience with schedule risk analysis methodologies and probabilistic forecasting techniques. Understanding of delay analysis methods and forensic schedule analysis for claims management. Exposure to lean construction principles, pull planning, and collaborative planning approaches.
  
  
**Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills**
Strong analytical capabilities to identify schedule trends, performance patterns, and emerging risks from complex data sets. Problem-solving mindset to develop creative solutions for schedule challenges, resource conflicts, and sequencing constraints. Critical thinking ability to evaluate contractor schedules, identify logic flaws, and recommend improvements. Scenario planning skills to model alternative execution strategies and assess time-cost tradeoffs.
  
  
**Communication & Stakeholder Management**
Excellent presentation skills with ability to communicate complex schedule information clearly to diverse audiences including executives, technical teams, and contractors. Report writing capability to prepare comprehensive schedule narratives, impact analyses, and executive summaries. Facilitation skills to lead productive planning meetings, resolve scheduling disputes, and build consensus among stakeholders. Ability to communicate schedule implications of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders in accessible language.
  
  
**Personal Attributes**
Detail-oriented with exceptional organizational skills to manage multiple concurrent schedules and deliverables. Proactive mindset anticipating schedule challenges and implementing preventive measures. Resilient under pressure with ability to maintain schedule accuracy during fast-paced project phases. Collaborative team player who builds effective relationships with contractors, consultants, and internal teams. Integrity in schedule reporting, providing honest assessments even when delivering unfavorable news.
  
  
**Working Conditions & Expectations**
This position is based in Gujarat with primary office presence at the Dholera project site or regional office. Regular site visits required to verify progress, assess work conditions, and validate contractor schedule updates. Work schedule typically follows standard business hours with flexibility required during critical project phases, milestone deliveries, or schedule crunches. Occasional travel to Ahmedabad, Mumbai, or vendor facilities for coordination meetings, training, or equipment factory acceptance testing. Position demands high responsiveness to address urgent schedule queries, support decision-making, and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
  
  
**Reporting Structure**
This position reports to the Project Manager or Project Director for the Adani Data Centre project, with functional coordination with JLL's planning and controls team leadership.
  
  
*This role offers an exceptional opportunity to lead schedule management for one of India's most significant data centre infrastructure projects in the emerging Dholera Smart City ecosystem. The Planning Lead will play a pivotal role in ensuring on-time delivery of this mission-critical facility through rigorous schedule management, proactive planning, and strategic coordination.*

Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
  
  
Systra India's design business line is the leading design team for metros, highways, special bridges, Urban Planning and water projects in India. We are also very proud to have designed the first monopile in India for the Mumbai Coastal Road project. We have the distinction of designing the fastest implemented metro project in the country with Lucknow and now have broken the record in Kanpur Metro. We are also conversant with BIM (Building Information Modelling) which enhances all stages of the infrastructure life cycle, from design to construction and maintenance, which is why we integrate it into our projects and offer it to our clients. title: Manager, QC Environment Monitoring
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* Lead and manage the Environmental Monitoring (EM) program for sterile injectable and peptide manufacturing areas (Grade A, B, C, D cleanrooms) including Isolator based lines.
* Individual should have thorough knowledge of microbiology as well.
* Design, review, and execute EM strategies including:

+ Viable and non-viable particle monitoring
+ Air, surface, personnel monitoring
+ Compressed gas and utility monitoring
+ Viable settle plate and active air sampling programs

* Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines including EU GMP Annex 1, USFDA aseptic guidance, WHO GMP, and internal CCS (Contamination Control Strategy).
* Develop, review, and approve EM SOPs, protocols, and reports.
* Lead microbial trending, data evaluation, and periodic review of environmental monitoring results.
* Investigate EM excursions, contamination events, and atypical results; perform root cause analysis and implement CAPA.
* Involve in change control review and approval, Deviation, Investigation and root cause investigation.
* Involve in SOP Review and its implementation and Training.
* Coordinate with QA, Production, Engineering, Validation, and QC teams for contamination control and sterile manufacturing assurance.
* Ensure qualification and routine monitoring of cleanrooms, LAFs, biosafety cabinets, isolators, and HVAC systems from microbiological perspective.
* Oversee microbiological sampling activities during routine production, media fills, and validation batches.
* Ensure proper operation, calibration, and maintenance of EM instruments (active air samplers, particle counters, contact plates, etc.).
* Maintain aseptic practices and hygiene compliance within controlled manufacturing environments.
* Support media fill simulations and aseptic process simulations (APS) with microbiological oversight.
* Ensure data integrity compliance (ALCOA+) in EM data recording and reporting systems (LIMS and manual records).
* Participate in regulatory inspections and client audits by presenting EM strategy, data, and investigations.
* Drive continuous improvement in contamination control practices and EM program effectiveness.
* Provide training to microbiology and production personnel on aseptic behavior and contamination prevention practices.

**Eligibility**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* M.Sc. (Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences) or equivalent qualification with Minimum 15–18 years of relevant experience in QC Microbiology with strong Environmental Monitoring exposure

Strong Experience in sterile injectable manufacturing environment is mandatory/ preferred.

Sound knowledge of the Avsec regulations and procedures.

**Team Collaboration**
Collaborate with team members to foster a supportive and efficient working environment, sharing knowledge and resources.

Collect participant feedback on training sessions to identify strengths and areas for improvement in delivery and content.

title: Proposal Engineer
description:
Role Overview

Sumip Composites Private Limited is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive 
**Proposal Executive**
 to support our business development and sales functions through accurate, competitive, and timely techno-commercial proposals.

The Proposal Executive will be responsible for managing the proposal process from the receipt of a customer enquiry or RFQ through preparation, internal coordination, submission, revision, and follow-up.

The role requires strong coordination across departments, commercial awareness, attention to detail, and the ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into well-structured proposals.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced B2B manufacturing environment where multiple enquiries and proposals may need to be managed simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities1. Enquiry & RFQ Management

* Review customer enquiries, RFQs, tender documents, BOQs, specifications, and other relevant documents.
* Understand the customer's technical, commercial, documentation, and delivery requirements.
* Identify missing information or clarifications required before proposal preparation.
* Coordinate with the Sales team or customer-facing teams to obtain necessary inputs.
* Maintain systematic records of incoming enquiries and their current status.

2. Techno-Commercial Proposal Preparation

* Prepare accurate and professional techno-commercial proposals, quotations, and commercial offers based on customer requirements.
* Ensure that product specifications, quantities, pricing, taxes, delivery terms, payment terms, validity, freight, and other commercial conditions are accurately incorporated.
* Prepare revised quotations and proposals based on customer feedback or changes in requirements.
* Ensure that all proposals follow the company's approved formats, commercial policies, and documentation standards.
* Review proposals thoroughly before submission to minimize technical, pricing, and documentation errors.

3. Internal Coordination

* Coordinate closely with 
  **Sales, Design, Production, Purchase, Planning, Quality, Finance, and other relevant departments**
   to collect the inputs required for proposal preparation.
* Obtain technical specifications, drawings, costing inputs, manufacturing feasibility, lead times, and commercial approvals wherever required.
* Follow up internally to ensure that pending inputs do not delay proposal submissions.
* Act as a central coordination point between commercial and technical teams during the proposal stage.

4. Costing & Commercial Support

* Assist in preparing preliminary costing, price comparisons, and commercial calculations.
* Coordinate for material, manufacturing, bought-out component, transportation, and other relevant costing inputs.
* Support the team in evaluating commercial terms before final proposal submission.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding pricing, margins, costing structures, and other sensitive commercial information.

5. Proposal Tracking & Follow-Up

* Maintain a structured tracker for all enquiries, quotations, revisions, and submitted proposals.
* Monitor proposal deadlines and ensure submissions are completed within committed timelines.
* Coordinate with the Sales and Business Development teams for follow-up on submitted proposals.
* Record customer feedback, technical clarifications, commercial negotiations, revisions, and final outcomes.
* Track proposal status from 
  **Enquiry → Proposal → Revision/Negotiation → Order/Lost**
   for better visibility and reporting.

6. Tender & Bid Documentation

* Support the preparation of tender submissions, bid documents, technical compliance sheets, commercial documentation, and supporting documents.
* Ensure all mandatory documents are compiled and submitted according to tender requirements.
* Maintain proper records of tender submissions and subsequent clarifications or revisions.

7. Documentation & MIS

* Maintain organized digital and physical records of proposals, quotations, customer enquiries, revisions, approvals, and supporting documents.
* Maintain and regularly update customer and enquiry databases.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports covering enquiry volume, quotation status, pending proposals, conversions, and other relevant proposal metrics.
* Ensure proper version control for revised quotations and proposals.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in 
  **Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline**
  .
* **1–3 years of experience**
   in Proposal Management, Tendering, Estimation, Sales Coordination, Inside Sales, or a similar role.
* Previous experience in a 
  **B2B manufacturing, engineering, electrical, infrastructure, or industrial organization**
  will be preferred.
* Fresh graduates with strong analytical ability, communication skills, and willingness to understand technical products may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong coordination and interpersonal skills.
* Good numerical and analytical ability.
* Ability to understand technical specifications, BOQs, commercial terms, and customer documentation.
* Proficiency in 
  **Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint**
  .
* Strong documentation and record-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple enquiries simultaneously.
* Ability to work efficiently under deadlines and follow up proactively with multiple departments.
* Commercial awareness and ability to handle confidential pricing information responsibly.

Preferred Skills

* Experience preparing techno-commercial quotations for industrial products.
* Familiarity with RFQs, tenders, BOQs, technical datasheets, and commercial terms.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes or engineered products.
* Experience with ERP/CRM systems will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to GRP/FRP, electrical, mechanical, infrastructure, or related industrial products would be beneficial.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance for this role will primarily be evaluated on:

* **On-time Proposal Submission:**
   Percentage of quotations and proposals submitted within committed timelines.
* **Proposal Accuracy:**
   Accuracy of pricing, quantities, specifications, commercial terms, and documentation.
* **Turnaround Time:**
   Efficiency in converting enquiries into complete proposals.
* **Documentation Quality:**
   Proper maintenance and traceability of quotations, revisions, approvals, and customer records.
* **Internal Coordination:**
   Effectiveness in obtaining timely inputs from Sales, Design, Production, Purchase, Finance, and other departments.
* **Proposal Follow-Up:**
   Timely tracking of submitted proposals, revisions, and customer feedback.
* **Process Compliance:**
   Adherence to company proposal formats, approval processes, pricing confidentiality, and documentation standards.
* **Sales Support Effectiveness:**
   Contribution towards improving proposal responsiveness and supporting enquiry-to-order conversion.

title: Lead Architect
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Our People & Places Solutions business – reinforces our drive to improve the lives of people everywhere and epitomizes the "why" of what we do – the tremendous positive impact and value our solutions bring to our communities and society as a whole. From facilities delivering life-saving therapies and ensuring clean water to enabling the connection of people through all modes of transportation and providing access to technology – we're integrating a multitude of these solution elements to build the smart environments of tomorrow.
  
  
Start your Jacobs career with a company that inspires and empowers you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow.
  
  
At Jacobs, advanced facilities simplify our everyday lives, enabling technology to connect us. We push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected and more sustainable.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Experience of 12+ years in handling advanced facilities for the Pharmaceutical, FMCG, Microelectronics sectors and their associated R&D facilities.
* Preparation of Schematic layout incorporating process equipment per PFD and Process datainput. Space planning per equipment sizes, logical movement of Personnel, Materials, Washing, Waste movement in the production facility. Ability to generate multiple options with minimal inputs from client, other disciplines.
* Planning should be compliant with GMP requirements able to satisfy final validation requirements per inspecting agencies.
* Well versed with Plasma fractionation, Cell and Gene Therapy, Bio Pharma facilities catering to Vaccines, Hormones, Monoclonal antibodies and Therapeutic Enzymes. Apply experience and knowledge to design new facility types.
* Well versed with Micro Electronics facilities such as OSATs, FAB buildings and associated CUP, site utilities.
* Explain production facility concepts to clients, present various options for production facilities, material handling concepts, supporting utility options, site master planning, site development scenarios, and be able to get a buy in from the client on an option that satisfies the program objectives.
* Author the concept of personnel gowning requirements as applicable for the project. Incorporatesafety in design over and above statutory norms.
* Be ready to challenge client requirements or defend a proposed design option with a client on technical grounds to get the best solution as the result.
* Lead the sustainability efforts on a project and assign components to various disciplines, internaland external stake holders as required.
* Able to work as individual contributor during the feasibility, concept and basic phases and use various visualization and presentation software tools including BIM and hand sketches to accomplish required results.
* Science background preferred in pre collage curriculum and a clear understanding of Chemicals& solvents and their impact on statutory compliance and Building Architecture.
* Thorough knowledge of codes mainly but not limited to – NBC, CCOE, Factory Inspector, HAC, GMP & EU guidelines (for pharma), IBC, IFC, Solvent and Hazardous Gases compliance codes.
* Thorough understanding of Cleanroom details and fabrication process coordination with all stakeholders.
* Able to act as a design leader during the preliminary project phases to enable other engineering disciplines to be onboarded. Transition to a key support role and incorporate other discipline requirements in the detail design phase.
* Detail out the layouts as it progresses the design phases, add Architectural elements per the relevant detail level, define the Architectural vocabulary for the building and site development, specify construction materials, detailing complex elements to enable smooth site execution, provide critical inputs during site visits and construction, resolve queries and any challenges that may arise during construction drawing upon experience to provide a suitable solution.
* Coordinate and align with all disciplines through all project stages to accomplish project success
* Be a brand ambassador for Jacobs at industry events, conferences and gatherings highlighting our technical excellence and emphasizing our corporate values of sustainable development.

Here's what you'll need
  
  
Full time Bachelor of Architecture (5 years, 10 semesters) from an Institute recognized by the COA India
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

title: Deputy General Manager- Techno Commercial
description:
****About Business:****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The TCD Site Executive (OPEX) is responsible for overseeing the procurement and inventory management of OPEX items required for operational activities across all mining sites. The role ensures the timely and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services, maintaining optimal inventory levels to support continuous site operations.
  
  
****JOB RESPONSIBILITIES****
**Category In-charge (CAPEX) - NR**
****Strategic Procurement And Supplier Management:****
Coordinate procurement activities across sites, ensuring strategic planning and alignment with operational needs.
  
  
Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers to procure quality OPEX items, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to quality standards.
  
  
Manage supplier relationships to negotiate favorable terms and ensure continuous improvement in vendor performance.
  
  
Lead process improvement initiatives in purchasing, contract management, supplier selection, and sourcing to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
  
  
**Inventory Management:**
Monitor and manage inventory levels to ensure availability of OPEX items, minimizing excess stock and obsolescence.
  
  
Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies to maintain accurate records.
  
  
Determine optimal reorder points and quantities to prevent stockouts and ensure uninterrupted site operations.
  
  
Generate and analyze inventory reports to identify trends, forecast needs, and inform procurement decisions.
  
  
Review inventory levels periodically and take necessary actions to maintain optimal stock at all sites.
  
  
**Financial And Budget Management:**
Conduct cost analysis of procurement activities to identify savings opportunities and drive cost reduction initiatives.
  
  
Ensure procurement activities are within budgetary constraints and provide regular updates to management on budget status.
  
  
Manage buying processes efficiently, including RFPs, proposal evaluations, negotiations, vendor selection, and contract awards.
  
  
Prepare and issue purchase orders for required OPEX items, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.
  
  
**Operational Coordination And Reporting:**
Coordinate with site managers and operational teams to understand OPEX requirements and ensure timely delivery of needed items.
  
  
Address and resolve procurement or inventory issues to ensure smooth operational activities.
  
  
Manage urgent procurement requests to support unplanned operational needs and minimize downtime.
  
  
Attend to internal/external audit queries, provide data, and take corrective actions for observations received.
  
  
Review commercial/stores SOPs annually, make necessary changes, and update the revision.
  
  
Review Pending PRs status with team members and take necessary corrective actions, providing performance feedback.
  
  
Attend review meetings conducted by TCD Leads/site head/corporate and prepare necessary data and presentations on OPEX-related procurements and inventory.
  
  
Release all e-NFA documents after checking the support documents and follow up for timely approval.
  
  
Check and release New Vendor code, VC unblock, and GRN error in MDG portal.
  
  
Review reports on inventory stock at all sites and follow up with contractors for monthly consumption reports.
  
  
**Compliance And Quality Assurance:**
Ensure compliance with quality, legal, financial, and safety terms in OPEX purchase and service contracts.
  
  
Monitor material/service providers’ performance and take necessary action to bridge gaps and ensure timely renewal of contracts.
  
  
Manage all commercial processes and data as per IMS standards, update data, attend audits, and address observations.
  
  
**Technology Integration:**
Deploy digital tools for real-time monitoring and optimization of operational expenditures on site, enhancing cost efficiency and project outcomes.
  
  
Implement advanced digital solutions for managing site operations and resource allocation, ensuring effective and efficient use of operational resources.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Sites Projects team
  
  
Marketing department
  
  
Finance & Accounts team
  
  
Quality Assurance Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Vendors
  
  
Suppliers
  
  
External agencies
  
  
Auditors
  
  
****RESPONSIBILITIES****
Strategic Sourcing:
  
  

* Plan and forecast Capex procurement needs based on the projects in pipeline and organization's strategic objectives.
* Formulate contractual terms and conditions for major EPC contracts to secure favorable terms.
* Negotiate with vendors for long-term contract terms to ensure beneficial agreements.
* Select the bidding process, prepare vendor selection approaches, and vendor evaluation criteria to streamline the procurement process.
* Review RFI and RFP documents, identify potential bidders, and organize pre-bid meetings to facilitate a competitive bidding process.
* Conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations and fact-based negotiations/e-auctions to select the best vendors.
* Review Notes for Approval (NFA) for selected bidders and obtain required approvals to ensure compliance with company policies.
* Leverage extensive experience in mining and material handling procurement, including handling mining and EPC contractors, explosives, CHPP, and project monitoring to develop and implement procurement strategies.

**Core Procurement Activities:**

* Understand the Techno-Commercial strategy and plan for the Business Unit (BU) to implement strategic initiatives for all categories (Group-wide/BU specific) as per plan.
* Oversee the review of approved PRs from user departments to ensure correctness and completeness of PRs.
* Coordinate with leads in identifying the type and method of procurement based on material/service type, urgency, stock availability, rate contracts, value, and delivery timeline to optimize procurement efficiency.

**Contract Management:**

* Oversee the preparation of contract documents as per protocols and standard templates to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Set up approved contract records within the ERP system to maintain accurate and accessible records.
* Maintain contract documents for future reference and compliance to ensure traceability and accountability.
* Collate Advance Bank Guarantee/Contract Performance Bank Guarantee (ABG/CPBG)/Customs related documents from vendors to secure financial assurances.
* Prepare, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved NFAs to secure long-term pricing agreements.
* Prepare master outline agreements in ERP systems based on rate contracts to streamline procurement processes.
* Prepare PO/SO for procurement under valid rate contracts to facilitate timely procurement.

**Supplier Management:**

* Oversee the identification of vendor evaluation criteria in consultation with quality, engineering, and project management departments to ensure rigorous vendor selection.
* Ensure completeness of forms submitted by vendors and update the approved vendor list to maintain an accurate and up-to-date vendor database.
* Coordinate with new vendors for evaluation documents and with quality/engineering/user teams for assessments if required to ensure comprehensive vendor evaluations.
* Prepare vendor segmentation matrices and performance evaluation criteria to categorize and assess vendor performance effectively.
* Oversee the evaluation process for CapEx and services vendors, ensuring thorough review of vendor scorecards.
* Plan improvement actions for vendors with unsatisfactory performance to enhance vendor performance.
* Manage all cluster CAPEX commercial activities and site TC functions as per Delegation of Authority (DoA) to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

**Data Management And Risk Management:**

* Collate and analyze data related to large scale procurement activities (e.g., commodity analysis, supplier debugging) to derive actionable insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and value through data analysis to drive continuous improvement.
* Identify procurement risks for assigned categories using master lists, supply market analysis, long-term procurement plans, annual procurement plans, and project risk registers to mitigate risks.

**People Management:**

* Work towards achieving set goals and participate in performance reviews to stay aligned with team objectives.
* Communicate personal development needs and actively engage in creating and following Individual Development Plans (IDP) for professional growth.
* Develop skills in current and future functional focus areas as per the capability matrix and IDP guidelines to contribute to team versatility.

**Technology Integration:**

* Utilize digital solutions for comprehensive tracking and analysis of capital expenditure projects, ensuring accurate forecasting and budgeting.
* Implement digital tools for project management and reporting, improving transparency and efficiency in Capex initiatives.
* Contribute to action planning and implementation based on data analytics to enhance CAPEX procurement strategies.

**Key Internal Stakeholders:**
Projects team
  
  
Marketing department
  
  
Finance & Accounts team
  
  
Quality Assurance Team
  
  
**Key External Stakeholders:**
Vendors
  
  
Suppliers
  
  
External agencies
  
  
****QUALIFICATIONS****
**Work Experience (Range of years):**
**Work Experience (Range Of Years):**
More than 12 years of experience in supply chain management, procurement.

title: Quantity Surveyor
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
**Our Purpose**
Water and our natural environment are the foundation of life, society and economies. The East of England has unique rivers, wetlands and coastlines, yet it is classified as severely water stressed and faces drought and a degrading natural environment. This is due to a combination of a growing economy, the highest rate of new housing development in the UK, climate change and being a major agricultural producer. Anglian Water’s purpose is to bring environmental and social prosperity to the East of England, through our commitment to Love Every Drop. Anglian Water have an ambitious capital investment programme that will provide safe and resilient water supplies, permit sustainable growth, provide climate change resilience, and protect and improve the natural environment.
  
  
**Role**
We are seeking a motivated Quantity Surveyor to join our team. In this role, you will report to seniors and take responsibility for the commercial and cost management of projects or programmes from initiation through to completion. Acting as the commercial lead within the delivery team, you will provide essential support to both the Project Manager and Construction team. Your focus will be on managing costs effectively, maximising value, and minimising future risks, all while ensuring the highest standards of quality and safety are maintained.
  
  
**Key responsibilities include:**
Leadership
  

* Taking the lead for the Commercial aspects of project delivery
* Foster a collaborative, performance-driven culture ensuring the highest standards in commercial practices.

Delivery
  

* Work closely with procurement, Construction Manager, and Project Manager to develop and monitor procurement strategy.
* Regularly engage with the site team to manage outputs, challenge performance, and communicate necessary changes.

Commercial Awareness
  

* Oversee commercial and cost management for assigned projects.
* Collaborate with the estimating team to ensure accurate estimates that account for scope, risks, and opportunities.
* Facilitate feedback on actual costs to inform estimators.
* Ensure proper preparation and management of subcontracts in line with contractual obligations.
* Maintain up-to-date contract files, responding to communications and managing payments and events.

Stakeholder & Communications
  

* Maintain a strong relationship with the project delivery team.
* Maintain a strong relationship with our supply chain.

Innovation – Always exploring
  

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives in commercial processes and tools.
* Explore and implement new commercial strategies that support sustainable outcomes.
* Challenge and recommend actions to achieve and improve efficiencies, and create an environment of outperformance

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Civil Engineering a related discipline OR demonstrable equivalent experience.
* Proven experience working as a Quantity Surveyor in construction, infrastructure, or related industries
* Membership of a relevant professional body (e.g., RICS, CICES)
* Experience with NEC3 PSC and ECC contracts with the client and the supply chain, with emphasis on Option C
* Hands-on experience with pre- and post-contract QS duties (budgeting, variations, valuations, final accounts).
* Experience working with Clients, contractors, and a multidisciplinary team across multiple project stages.
* Proficiency in QS software tools (e.g Excel, FastDraft, DocuSign)
* Experience requied min 6+ in Quantity Surveyor.

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave

title: Production Executive – Fine Jewellery
description:
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Work Arrangement:**
Work from the office

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent

**Experience:**
Relevant experience in jewelry production or manufacturing

**Compensation:**
Commensurate with experience

Company Overview

Our client is a growing fine jewelry house based in Ahmedabad, operating two distinct brands within the contemporary luxury segment. The organization brings together a close-knit team of designers, visual thinkers, and engineers united by a shared passion for craft, design, and storytelling. With a presence in multiple Indian cities and a design-led approach, the company works at the intersection of traditional Indian craftsmanship and modern design sensibility. This role exists to bridge the creative studio and the production floor, ensuring that design concepts are translated into finished pieces of exceptional quality.

About the Role

In this role, you will be the operational backbone connecting the design studio to the production floor. You will work closely with designers, production leadership, vendors, and artisans to transform collection briefs into production-ready pieces — managing timelines, sourcing materials, monitoring quality, and solving problems before they delay a launch.

This is a hands-on coordination role suited to someone who understands fine jewelry production deeply, communicates clearly across teams, and takes ownership of the entire production lifecycle from sampling through delivery. You will be central to ensuring that every piece meets the brand's exacting standards for craftsmanship and finish.

Key Responsibilities

* Collaborate with design and creative teams to interpret collection briefs and develop production plans
* Coordinate with production leadership, vendors, and artisans to execute prototypes and final pieces on schedule
* Oversee the full production lifecycle — sampling, prototyping, fabrication, and final delivery
* Monitor production timelines against collection launch calendars and flag risks proactively
* Maintain quality control standards at every stage of production
* Source and manage raw materials including gemstones, metals, and components
* Track inventory, production costs, and resource utilization
* Liaise with internal teams (design, merchandising, operations) to ensure seamless workflow
* Identify process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce production delays

Required Qualifications

**Education:**
Degree or relevant experience in Jewelry Production, Manufacturing, or a related field

**Experience:**
Demonstrated experience in fine jewelry production or a closely related manufacturing environment

**Knowledge:**

* Strong understanding of fine jewelry production processes and techniques
* Working knowledge of gemstones, materials, and fabrication methods
* Familiarity with artisan coordination and vendor management in the jewelry sector

**Skills:**

* Excellent organizational and coordination abilities
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail with a focus on quality and craftsmanship

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with both traditional Indian jewelry techniques and contemporary design
* Exposure to bridal or heirloom jewelry production
* Familiarity with inventory or production tracking systems

Technical Skills

**Production:**
Jewelry manufacturing processes, sampling, prototyping, fabrication

**Materials:**
Gemstones, precious metals, component sourcing

**Coordination:**
Vendor management, artisan liaison, cross-functional collaboration

**Quality:**
Quality control standards, craftsmanship assessment

What You Will Bring

You understand that fine jewelry production is as much about relationships and timing as it is about materials and technique. You have worked with artisans and vendors long enough to know how to communicate expectations clearly and follow up consistently. You are comfortable juggling multiple pieces and collections at different stages simultaneously, and you know how to prioritize when deadlines tighten. You notice the details — a setting that isn't quite right, a finish that needs another pass — and you speak up before small issues become delays. Most importantly, you take pride in being the person who ensures that what was designed actually gets made, and made well.

Why This Opportunity

* **Dual-brand exposure:**
  Work across two distinct fine jewelry brands — one rooted in bridal and heirloom traditions, the other exploring modern fine jewelry through contemporary design
* **Craft-centered environment:**
  Join a collaborative team of designers, visual thinkers, and engineers united by a passion for excellence
* **In-house artisan network:**
  Coordinate with a dedicated team of skilled artisans producing handcrafted pieces
* **Growth-stage luxury house:**
  Be part of an organization building a considered luxury brand with long-term ambitions

How to Apply

If this opportunity aligns with your experience in jewelry production and your career goals, we would like to hear from you. Please share your updated resume with Camellia Staffing for consideration

Ability to manage multiple work fronts under site conditions.

title: Lead – QMS & ESG
description:
Soleos Energy Limited is seeking an experienced Lead – QMS & ESG to establish, implement, manage and continuously improve the company's Quality Management System (QMS) and Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) framework across its operations and projects.

The incumbent will drive quality systems, process governance, audits, sustainability performance, ESG policies, environmental and social compliance, ESG data and reporting, risk management and continuous improvement. The role requires practical, hands-on experience in both QMS and ESG, along with the ability to work independently with senior management and cross-functional teams. Experience in Solar EPC / IPP / Renewable Energy will be a strong added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Quality Management System (QMS)**

• Own, implement and continuously improve the organisation-wide Quality Management System.

• Develop, review and maintain Quality Manuals, SOPs, policies, process maps, procedures, checklists, work instructions and departmental quality standards.

• Establish systems for document control, process compliance, change management, traceability and record keeping.

• Drive implementation and continual improvement of ISO 9001 and other applicable management-system standards.

• Develop and monitor departmental and organisational quality KPIs, MIS and management dashboards.

• Plan and conduct internal process, site, vendor, customer and certification audits, and coordinate closure of audit findings.

• Establish and manage NCR, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA) systems, with focus on eliminating recurring issues.

• Guide project teams on Project Quality Plans / QAPs, ITPs, inspection systems, supplier quality and handover documentation, where applicable.

• Conduct periodic management reviews and report QMS performance, major non-conformities, systemic risks and improvement actions to Management.

**B. ESG & Sustainability**

• Develop and implement Soleos's ESG strategy, policies, governance framework and implementation roadmap.

• Establish measurable ESG objectives, KPIs and reporting mechanisms covering Environmental, Social and Governance parameters.

• Create systems for collection, validation, consolidation and reporting of ESG-related data across departments, projects and entities.

• Monitor environmental performance including energy use, greenhouse-gas emissions, water, waste, resource efficiency and environmental compliance.

• Support development and implementation of Environmental & Social Management Systems (ESMS) for applicable projects.

• Coordinate ESG / E&S due-diligence requirements of investors, lenders, customers and other stakeholders.

• Establish and monitor appropriate frameworks relating to workforce practices, health & safety interface, human rights, ethics, governance, grievance mechanisms, community / stakeholder considerations and responsible supply chain.

• Coordinate ESG assessments, sustainability audits, third-party evaluations and closure of identified gaps.

• Support preparation of ESG / sustainability disclosures and reports in line with applicable customer, lender, regulatory or recognised reporting requirements.

• Monitor emerging ESG requirements and translate them into practical actions for the organisation.

**C. Solar EPC / IPP Project QMS & ESG**

• Support quality and ESG compliance across project development, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover and operations, as applicable.

• Identify environmental, social and quality risks at project and supply-chain level and ensure appropriate mitigation and monitoring plans.

• Drive contractor, subcontractor and supplier compliance with applicable project quality and ESG requirements.

• Support project teams during lender / investor technical, ESG and E&S due diligence, including data-room documentation and action tracking.

• Support compliance with project-specific environmental and social commitments and internationally accepted E&S standards where applicable.

**D. Audits, Compliance & Management Reporting**

• Develop and manage an annual QMS and ESG audit calendar covering functions, projects, vendors and critical processes.

• Coordinate ISO certification, surveillance and recertification audits and ensure timely closure of observations and non-conformities.

• Maintain dashboards for QMS performance, ESG performance, audits, NCR / CAPA ageing, recurring issues, key risks and action closures.

• Conduct periodic management reviews and recommend corrective, preventive and improvement initiatives.

• Work with department heads to establish clear ownership, timelines and accountability for all QMS and ESG actions.

title: Chief Digital Officer
description:
**The Chief Digital & AI Officer will define and implement the AI and digital strategy for the roads, metro, rail and water businesses at Adani. The role calls for a visionary strategic orientation, the ability to drive change, execute for results, and lead cross-functional data and engineering teams.**

**The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial, strategic and analytically driven leader with deep expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI and data architectures — and with genuine knowledge of infrastructure project delivery and O&M. The mandate is to use AI and digital to compress project schedules, protect EPC margin, improve safety on site, and maximise asset uptime, toll revenue integrity and water network efficiency, ushering in an AI-first operating model across the portfolio.**

**Education & Certification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or Business Administration.
* Certifications in AI/ML (Deep Learning, MLOps), Digital Transformation or Cloud AI architectures (Azure/AWS/GCP) will be a strong advantage.
* Engineering background (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics) is preferred given the project environment.
* 18–22 years of experience overall, with 6–8 years in a senior digital, AI or technology leadership role.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **AI-Driven Strategy:**
  define and implement a clearly defined AI and digital transformation agenda aligned with the business strategy across project development, construction and O&M.
* **Operationalising AI:**
  design, deploy and run AI-enhanced processes — schedule risk prediction, cost overrun early warning, computer vision for progress and safety, leak detection, traffic and revenue forecasting — with ownership of business outcomes.
* **Project and Asset Intelligence:**
  establish integrated digital project controls and BIM-based digital delivery so the CEO has one trusted view of every project, and O&M assets are managed on condition rather than calendar.
* **Revenue and Network Integrity:**
  deploy analytics for toll and ETC revenue assurance and for non-revenue water reduction across water assets.
* **Cultural Transformation:**
  inculcate a culture that is AI-first, data-led, agile and attuned to algorithmic thinking — including among site engineers, project directors and subcontractor teams.
* **Thought Leadership & Governance:**
  provide thought leadership to senior stakeholders on AI as a lever for growth, and establish robust AI governance, data privacy and ethical AI frameworks.
* **Technology Advocacy:**
  educate the business on emerging AI trends (GenAI, LLMs, Edge AI), opportunities, competitive threats and new algorithms that can differentiate delivery and operations.
* **Modernisation & AI Infrastructure:**
  make build-vs-buy decisions for AI models and data platforms; convert legacy systems into AI-ready applications through integrated, scalable data architectures (data lakes, MLOps pipelines) spanning ERP, project management, BIM, tolling, SCADA and HSE data.
* **Portfolio & Partner Ecosystem:**
  manage the AI/digital portfolio with shared accountability for value creation and ROI; grow internal capability and manage an ecosystem of AI vendors, EPC partners, ITS/tolling OEMs, hyperscalers and start-ups.
* **Talent Development:**
  build a world-class team of data scientists, ML engineers and digital experts, supported by embedded digital leads at project and asset level.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  influence and align the CEO, CFO, project directors, concessioning authorities, lenders and partners to ensure timely delivery of AI solutions.

**Sector Knowledge (Mandatory)**

* Hands-on experience in highways, metro, rail or water infrastructure — with a developer/concessionaire, major EPC contractor, authority, or a firm serving them.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure commercial models — HAM, BOT (Toll and Annuity), TOT, EPC and O&M concessions — and how digital affects IRR and EPC margin.
* Comfort with project delivery mechanics: BOQ and quantity certification, RA bills, EOT and variation claims, independent engineer processes and milestone payments.
* Practical exposure to ITS/ATMS, tolling and FASTag ecosystems, SCADA for water and transit, and BIM common data environments.
* Familiarity with NHAI/MoRTH, metro rail authority and urban water reporting frameworks.

**Behavioural Skills**

* Visionary strategic orientation with a strong AI-first mindset.
* Change management and AI adoption expertise.
* Executive maturity, ethical AI advocacy and an analytical point of view.
* Entrepreneurial spirit and resilience.
* Collaborative, driven, and capable of demystifying complex AI concepts for business leaders.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep experience in defining an AI vision and data roadmap for large-scale businesses.
* Track record of working with CEOs and management teams to shape business requirements for algorithmic automation and digitalisation.
* Proficiency with ML algorithms, Generative AI applications, MLOps and familiarity with Python, R or equivalent.
* Experience setting up secure, enterprise-grade AI boundaries, data sovereignty controls and modern cloud/edge infrastructure.
* Ability to continuously scout for new AI breakthroughs, edge computing capabilities and emerging enterprise technology.
* Experience applying AI and computer vision across distributed field environments with limited connectivity and a subcontractor-heavy workforce.

title: Chief Digital Officer
description:
**The Chief Digital & AI Officer will define and implement the AI and digital strategy for the thermal generation businesses at Adani. The role calls for a visionary strategic orientation, the ability to drive change, execute for results, and lead cross-functional data and engineering teams.**

**The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial, strategic and analytically driven leader with deep expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI and data architectures — and with genuine knowledge of thermal power operations. The mandate is simple: use AI and digital to improve plant availability, lower heat rate and auxiliary power consumption, tighten the fuel chain and make plants safer, ushering in an AI-first operating model across the fleet.**

**Education & Certification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or Business Administration.
* Certifications in AI/ML (Deep Learning, MLOps), Digital Transformation or Cloud AI architectures (Azure/AWS/GCP) will be a strong advantage.
* Engineering background (Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation or Power) is preferred given the plant environment.
* 18–22 years of experience overall, with 6–8 years in a senior digital, AI or technology leadership role.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **AI-Driven Strategy:**
  define and implement a clearly defined AI and digital transformation agenda aligned with the generation business strategy, with leadership commitment, resource allocation and disciplined execution.
* **Operationalising AI:**
  design, deploy and run AI-enhanced processes — predictive maintenance, combustion and mill optimisation, computer vision, autonomous operations — to drive efficiency, profitability and growth, with ownership of business outcomes.
* **Fuel and Asset Intelligence:**
  digitise the coal and ash value chain end to end and deploy AI blending and reconciliation advisories that protect generation economics.
* **Cultural Transformation:**
  inculcate a culture that is AI-first, data-led, agile and attuned to algorithmic thinking — including at the plant floor, with shift engineers and unit heads.
* **Thought Leadership & Governance:**
  provide thought leadership to senior stakeholders on AI as a lever for growth, and establish robust AI governance, data privacy and ethical AI frameworks.
* **Technology Advocacy:**
  educate the business on emerging AI trends (GenAI, LLMs, Edge AI), opportunities, competitive threats and new algorithms that can differentiate operations.
* **Modernisation & AI Infrastructure:**
  make build-vs-buy decisions for AI models and data platforms; convert legacy plant and enterprise systems into AI-ready applications through integrated, scalable data architectures (data lakes, MLOps pipelines) spanning DCS, SCADA, historian, CBM and ERP data.
* **Cyber Security of OT:**
  ensure secure AI and data boundaries across plant control environments, with segmentation and access governance appropriate to critical national infrastructure.
* **Portfolio & Partner Ecosystem:**
  manage the AI/digital portfolio with shared accountability for value creation and ROI; grow internal capability and manage an ecosystem of AI vendors, OEMs, hyperscalers and start-ups.
* **Talent Development:**
  build a world-class team of data scientists, ML engineers and digital experts, supported by digital champions at each station.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  influence and align the CEO, CFO, plant heads, regulators and partners to ensure timely delivery of AI solutions.

**Sector Knowledge (Mandatory)**

* Hands-on experience in thermal power generation — with a utility/IPP, or in a senior role with an OEM, EPC or consulting firm serving thermal generators.
* Working knowledge of the thermal value chain: coal handling, milling, boiler and turbine operation, condenser and cooling, ash handling, FGD and grid evacuation.
* Comfort with generation metrics — heat rate, PLF/PAF, auxiliary power consumption, declared capacity, forced-outage rate — and the levers behind each.
* Practical exposure to DCS, SCADA, historians and condition-monitoring systems in multi-OEM plant environments.
* Familiarity with CEA, CERC/SERC, Grid-India scheduling and MoEFCC emission norms.

**Behavioural Skills**

* Visionary strategic orientation with a strong AI-first mindset.
* Change management and AI adoption expertise.
* Executive maturity, ethical AI advocacy and an analytical point of view.
* Entrepreneurial spirit and resilience.
* Collaborative, driven, and capable of demystifying complex AI concepts for business leaders.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep experience in defining an AI vision and data roadmap for large-scale businesses.
* Track record of working with CEOs and management teams to shape business requirements for algorithmic automation and digitalisation.
* Proficiency with ML algorithms, Generative AI applications, MLOps and familiarity with Python, R or equivalent.
* Experience setting up secure, enterprise-grade AI boundaries, data sovereignty controls and modern cloud/edge infrastructure.
* Ability to continuously scout for new AI breakthroughs, edge computing capabilities and emerging enterprise technology.
* Experience applying AI to industrial data — anomaly detection, remaining-useful-life, soft sensors and process optimisation — in live plant environments.

**Company Description:**
GreenTech Future Energy Solutions India Private Limited is a renewable energy project development and management company committed to building a cleaner, sustainable energy future. The organisation specialises in solar and wind energy projects, offering end-to-end support from concept and feasibility through execution and commissioning. With a combination of global experience, local expertise, and execution-focused project management, GreenTech enables developers, investors, and energy companies to deliver safe, efficient, and commercially successful projects. The WTG Installation Engineer will oversee and execute the installation, alignment, and commissioning of wind turbine generators (WTGs) at project sites in Gujarat. Day-to-day tasks involve reviewing technical drawings, planning required resources, inspecting equipment and wiring, documenting progress, and preparing installation and test reports. The role also includes supporting maintenance planning for newly commissioned turbines and contributing to continuous improvement of installation practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong equipment installation skills, including experience with WTG erection, tower assembly, and nacelle and blade installation.
* Candidates should possess electrical or mechanical engineering and be relevant to wind turbine installation.
* Candidates should possess mechanical engineering skills, with competence in mechanical assemblies, rotating equipment, and use of installation tools and lifting equipment.
* Degree or diploma in electrical or mechanical engineering (or a related field) from a recognised institution.
* Experience in wind power or renewable energy project execution, preferably in WTG installation or commissioning.
* Sound understanding of safety standards, permits-to-work, and HSE practices for construction and installation sites.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, manuals, and OEM documentation, with strong problem-solving and communication skills.
* Willingness to work at project sites, adapt to field conditions, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external partners.
