title: Senior Odoo Implementation Lead — Functional + Technical
description:
**Odoo Implementation Lead — Functional + Technical**

**Remote / Work from Home · Full-time · Marine & mining distribution, Africa · Program ownership**

We're a Netherlands-headquartered group — a large distributor of engines and spare parts into the marine and mining sectors across Africa. We represent leading global engine, driveline, filtration and equipment brands, and we run service and workshop operations alongside the distribution business. We're now consolidating new group companies onto Odoo as the operational backbone, and we need one person to own the programme end to end.

This is a hybrid role: functional-first (processes, configuration, reporting), but with the Python and Next.js integration to make real decisions on the technical side — and the project-management discipline to run a multi-phase, multi-entity rollout to deadline. You'll start hands-on, then build and lead a small delivery team as the programme scales, after 1 year.

The Odoo build has to deliver that visibility from day one: every entity, every brand, every sales order measured on true profitability, not turnover.

**THE PROGRAMME — THREE PHASES**

**Phase 1 — Core ERP build & migration**

* **Migrate (v19 → v19, then v19 → v20):**
  migrate our existing Odoo.sh v19 install onto a clean, unified Odoo.sh v19 domain for the group, then plan and execute the subsequent upgrade to v20.
* **Build – Rollout:**
  stand up new entities on Odoo from zero (distribution, sales, service, warehouse, workshop).
* **Group structure:**
  design and configure Odoo across all entities — multi-country, multi-currencies, intercompany flows, and company/country/brand hierarchies so every part and every sale traces back to its exact origin.
* **Data migration:**
  extract, map, cleanse and load historical data from SAP Business One and the existing Odoo Community install into the consolidated Odoo environment. Verify ledger balances, master data and open transactions. You own the integrity of what lands in the new system.
* **Third-party integration:**
  integrate the third-party Field Service Management and Workshop Management modules with the new entity built on Next.js front-end + Odoo Community back-end onto Odoo.sh — aligned, versioned and maintainable.
* **Reporting:**
  build the reporting layer the group runs on — dashboards, pivots and P&L views showing margin by product, sales order, brand, country and customer. Private-equity-grade visibility across every entity.
* Managing complete version-controlled SOP’s and procedures for complete rollout

**Phase 2 — Distribution platform**

* Build a customer-facing website that distributes parts and other items from Odoo inventory in real time, with social-media channels linked for marketing and lead capture and payment infrastructure. Next.js front-end, Odoo back-end.

**Phase 3 — Customer self-service**

* Deliver a separate web application giving customers live lead-time visibility against their open orders and enquiries — pulled directly from Odoo.

**THE ROLE**

* **Programme management:**
  you're accountable for scope, timeline, budget and quality across all three phases. Weekly status to the group management team.
* **Hands-on first, then team lead:**
  you'll do the heavy configuration, data mapping and reporting work yourself in Phase 1. By Phase 2 you're hiring and leading a small delivery team (functional + developers) you'll build out as projects demand.
* **Business partnership:**
  you work directly with our head-office team and the operating entities across the group with the respective senior managers. You translate business processes into clear SOPs and Odoo configuration, run key-user training, and own go-live.
* **Technical direction:**
  you set the standards for Odoo development on Odoo.sh — Python module work, Next.js front-end patterns, version control, release process. Our developers code to the pattern you set.
* **Administration & infrastructure:**
  you own the group's Odoo tenancy end-to-end — user provisioning across all entities, licences, roles and access rights, security policy, backups and recovery, Odoo.sh environments (dev/staging/production) and the network and hosting setup that sits around it.
* **Document & version control:**
  you keep the single source of truth for how we run on Odoo — every process SOP, workflow diagram and configuration document is versioned, dated, owned and current. If a step changes, the master document changes with it. No tribal knowledge, no out-of-date PDFs floating in email.
* **Reporting:**
  weekly written status to the group management team, and a stakeholder report tailored to each audience — operations, finance and the board — so everyone sees the programme from the angle they care about.
* **New projects:**
  beyond the three phases above, you own new customer-facing initiatives as they come up — scoping them, running them to delivery, and folding them into the Odoo backbone.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* **8–10 years**
  as an Odoo implementer, with full-lifecycle multi-company, multi-country rollouts behind you.
* **Python:**
  solid working knowledge is mandatory, not optional. You can write and review Odoo custom modules, data migration scripts, and extensions — not necessarily as a career developer, but confidently enough to lead the technical conversation and ship when needed.
* **Next.js:**
  solid working knowledge is mandatory. You understand the Neomoment-style architecture (Next.js front-end over an Odoo back-end) and can direct Next.js development, review PRs, and make architecture calls on front-end work.
* **Odoo.sh:**
  hands-on with hosting, deployment pipelines, staging/production discipline, and version management.
* **Data migration & upgrades:**
  direct experience moving complete enterprise datasets from SAP Business One to Odoo, Odoo-to-Odoo transfers between domains on Odoo.sh, and version upgrades (v19 → v20). SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, schema mapping, data cleansing.
* **Core modules:**
  operational command of Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Accounting, Project, Field Service and Repair / Maintenance in Odoo.
* **Reporting:**
  you've built dashboards, pivots and P&L / margin reporting that a management team actually runs on.
* **Project management:**
  you've managed delivery to a deadline, run status to stakeholders, and hired and led a small team.
* Fluent written and spoken English; comfortable across Indian and emerging-markets operating contexts.
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent experience.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Prior exposure to engine or spare-parts distribution, after-sales, marine or mining equipment businesses, or operations in Africa.
* Official Odoo certification v19.
* Experience building customer-facing e-commerce or self-service portals on top of Odoo.

**OTHERS**

* **Engagement:**
  full-time. Initially a one-year contract, extendable, with a permanent pathway for the right person.
* **Location:**
  remote / work from home. Base cities: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad or Bangalore.
* **Compensation:**
  as per experience and the technical depth you bring, with a clear performance bonus tied to each phase go-live.

**To apply:**
email your CV to
**hr@cep-holland.com**
, with a short note on an Odoo rollout — ideally one involving data migration, a Next.js front-end, or a multi-entity group — that you led end-to-end.

title: Sourcing Manager - Textile and Accessories
description:
**About Ecoright**

Ecoright is a design-led sustainable lifestyle brand, built in India for a global market. We make sustainability desirable — quirky, fashion-forward, and never preachy.

**The Role**

We're looking for a sourcing manager who knows the ground — factories, vendors, trims, and timelines. Someone who has sat across a supplier, negotiated hard, and still got the sample out on time. You'll own end-to-end sourcing across accessories and textiles, work closely with the design and product teams, and make sure what's on paper actually gets made.

**What You'll Do**

*Vendor Development & Management*

* Identify, evaluate, and onboard vendors across accessories and textiles
* Build and maintain a reliable vendor base — domestic and where relevant, international
* Conduct factory visits, audits, and performance reviews

*Buying & Procurement*

* Execute seasonal and ongoing buying in line with product plans and budgets
* Negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times, and payment terms
* Raise POs, track confirmations, and manage order books

*Product Development Support*

* Work with the design team from brief to bulk — trims, materials, construction
* Source and manage sampling for new product launches
* Maintain tech packs, material libraries, and approved vendor lists

*Quality & Compliance*

* Ensure materials and products meet brand quality standards
* Coordinate pre-production and inline checks with QC teams
* Flag and resolve quality issues before they hit production

*Operations & Planning*

* Track delivery timelines and proactively manage delays
* Maintain sourcing trackers, cost sheets, and vendor databases
* Coordinate with production, logistics, and finance teams

**What We're Looking For**

* 2–4 years of sourcing experience in fashion, accessories, or lifestyle products
* Hands-on accessories sourcing experience — bags, hardware, trims, packaging
* Textile sourcing experience — fabrics, print, embroidery, surface treatments
* Buying experience — you've owned a buy, not just supported one
* Strong negotiation skills and vendor relationship management
* Detail-oriented with solid follow-through on timelines and deliverables
* Comfortable working across multiple categories simultaneously

**What You Get**

* Ownership of the full sourcing function — not just execution support
* Work across multiple product categories as the brand grows
* A role that shapes the product, not just sources it

title: IMS Lead - Business Excellence
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL)**
: AGEL is part of the Adani Group’s promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group’s philosophy of Growth with Goodness’, the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility- scale grid-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government- backed corporations. On the back of long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar & wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round-the-clock green power to India’s grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Lead - Integrated Management System (IMS) is responsible for the strategic development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the Integrated Management System. This role ensures that IMS effectively integrates various management standards and frameworks, such as quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety systems. The Lead will focus on ensuring comprehensive compliance with industry standards, optimizing system performance, and driving operational efficiency through regular audits, process improvements, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**IMS Framework Design and Integration:**
Design and integrate a comprehensive Integrated Management System (IMS) that aligns with ISO standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and organizational objectives.
  
  
Ensure the IMS framework integrates quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management systems into a cohesive structure that enhances operational efficiency and regulatory compliance, leverage industry best practices and technological advancements to create a robust and scalable IMS.
  
  
**System Architecture And Process Optimization**
Develop and refine the architecture of the IMS to support seamless integration across various management systems.
  
  
Focus on process optimization by implementing advanced methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Management (BPM), utilize process mapping and simulation tools to identify inefficiencies and enhance process performance, ensuring that the IMS supports continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  
  
**Risk Management And Compliance Integration**
Integrate comprehensive risk management practices within the IMS to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks.
  
  
Implement advanced risk assessment tools and techniques, including probabilistic risk analysis and scenario planning, to ensure robust risk management, ensure that the IMS supports compliance with local, national, and international regulations by embedding compliance checks and controls within the system.
  
  
**Performance Monitoring And Data Analytics**
Establish advanced performance monitoring mechanisms using data analytics and real-time dashboards.
  
  
Implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of the IMS and its impact on organizational performance, utilize data analytics platforms and business intelligence tools to analyze performance trends, identify areas for improvement, and drive data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**Audit And Assurance Processes**
Develop and manage rigorous internal and external audit processes to ensure the integrity and effectiveness of the IMS, implement automated audit management systems to streamline audit processes, track findings, and ensure timely corrective actions.
  
  
Coordinate with certification bodies and regulatory agencies to maintain compliance and certification status.
  
  
**Technology Integration And System Upgrades**
Lead the integration of advanced technologies and digital solutions within the IMS to enhance system functionality and efficiency.
  
  
Explore and implement emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and blockchain to improve data accuracy, process automation, and system interoperability, plan and execute system upgrades to ensure the IMS remains current with technological advancements and industry standards.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Senior Leadership Team
  
  
Department SPOCs
  
  
Operations Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
External Auditors
  
  
Industry Certification Bodies
  
  
Regulatory Agencies
  
  
Consultants
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Engineering or a related field
  
  
Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or relevant certification in Operations Excellence (preferred)
  
  
**Work Experience**
8+ years of experience in managing integrated management systems
  
  
Certifications in IMS standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001)

description:

Ahmedabad
  
  
**Cadence**
is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality. Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health.

* The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact.
* Cadence’s employee-friendly policies focus on the physical and mental well-being of employees, career development, providing opportunities for learning, and celebrating success in recognition of specific needs of the employees.

**Job Summary**
Drives development of products and technologies and has material responsibility for the success of that product/technology. MM VIP PE is expected to become an expert in the Memory domain of Verification IP family – protocol and product-wise. The memory domain has many protocols such as SDRAM protocols (DDR5), SGRAM protocols (GDDR6), Memory Controller and PHY protocols (DFI), and others. The Cadence VIP Portfolio includes Memory Models that enable advanced verification of these protocols. The PE’s main role is to help accelerate VIP Portfolio adoption at Cadence’s top tier customers by supporting pre-sales technical activities. To ensure that, one must have strong verification expertise and understand customer design and verification flows. As a MM VIP and protocol expert, PE drives product knowledge transfer across our field engineers and customers, providing training and developing collaterals. The PE will also need to translate high-level requirements from customers into a technical spec and drive the product definition that fits the customer needs. The PE is expected to work independently and collaborate with other team members (R&D, Marketing, Customer Support, Field Teams) to ensure all dimensions of the product are aligned. This role requires approximately 20% travel and cross-site collaboration over multiple geographies (Asia Pacific, Europe, US-East, US-South and US-West).
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Leads projects with high resource, risk and/or complexity
* Develops and leads large and multiple cross-functional and cross-organizational programs, initiatives, and activities with high resource requirements, risk and/or complexity
* Continually evaluates technology effectiveness/data interoperability of complex systems
* Manages issue resolution with vendors on tech/product quality and functionality and influences vendor roadmap and direction of products
* Communicates highly complex ideas, anticipates potential objections and persuades others, often at senior levels, to adopt a different point of view.

**Experience And Technical Skills Required**

* At least 4 – 8 years of experience with Design and Verification
* Experience with Developing Verification environments using System Verilog
* Working knowledge and experience with the UVM methodology
* Good experience on solving complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors.
* Exercises judgment within broadly defined practices and policies in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
* Familiarity with Memory protocols is a must.
* Knowledge of the DFI protocol is a plus.

**Qualifications**

* BTech/BE/MTech/ME or equivalent with Electrical, Electronics & Comm or Computer Science Engineering

**Behavioral Skills Required**

* Must possess strong written, verbal and presentation skills
* Ability to establish a close working relationship with both customer peers and management
* Explore what’s possible to get the job done, including creative use of unconventional solutions
* Work effectively across functions and geographies
* Push to raise the bar while always operating with integrity

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

description:
**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate end-to-end land acquisition activities with the Site Land Team, Head Office, Legal, Projects, Finance, Commercial, EPC, and Business Development teams.
* Support identification, evaluation, and finalization of suitable land parcels for renewable energy projects, including solar, wind, hybrid parks, pooling substations, transmission corridors, access roads, laydown areas, and project infrastructure.
* Facilitate land due diligence including title verification, ownership checks, encumbrance review, revenue record verification, mutation status, land use classification, zoning, litigation checks, and verification of government restrictions.
* Coordinate land purchase, lease, right-of-use, easement, wayleave, and Right of Way documentation as per project requirements.
* Monitor land aggregation progress, landowner negotiations, consent collection, agreement execution, registration, stamp duty, mutation, demarcation, possession, and handover of land to project execution teams.
* Track and support statutory approvals, permits, NOCs, conversions, and clearances from revenue, forest, local administration, panchayat, DISCOM, state nodal agencies, pollution control, highways, railways, defence, airport authority, and other relevant authorities.
* Coordinate resolution of site-level issues including boundary disputes, encroachments, access constraints, community concerns, compensation-related matters, crop damages, and local stakeholder resistance.
* Maintain updated land MIS, approval trackers, agreement records, ownership documents, khasra/khatauni/7-12 extracts, FMB sketches, maps, survey reports, mutation records, land schedules, litigation status, and compliance documentation.
* Ensure adherence to applicable land laws, revenue laws, renewable energy policy guidelines, land ceiling provisions, forest and environmental regulations, local authority requirements, and internal governance processes.
* Act as the single coordination point between site and Head Office for escalation, reporting, review meetings, documentation closure, approval follow-ups, and project land readiness status.

Land & Estate Scope
  
  

* Land sourcing, land aggregation, land acquisition, land leasing, and land pooling coordination.
* Title search, legal due diligence, revenue due diligence, technical feasibility, boundary verification, site survey, demarcation, and possession.
* Land conversion, non-agriculture permission, change of land use, mutation, registration, encumbrance clearance, and land record updation.
* ROW, access road permissions, transmission line corridor coordination, pooling substation land, approach road land, and site infrastructure land requirements.
* Government liaisoning, statutory approvals, local administration coordination, panchayat interface, community engagement, and dispute resolution.
* Land documentation, agreement management, lease deeds, sale deeds, consent letters, affidavits, indemnities, NOCs, approval letters, and MIS reporting.

Technical Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of land acquisition, land aggregation, land revenue records, title due diligence, mutation, registration, stamp duty, and land conversion processes.
* Knowledge of renewable energy project land requirements, including solar, wind, hybrid projects, transmission lines, pooling substations, approach roads, and evacuation infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of Land & Estate documentation such as sale deeds, lease deeds, agreements to sell, MoUs, consent letters, ROW agreements, NOCs, maps, surveys, and land schedules.
* Understanding of statutory approvals, local permissions, government liaisoning, revenue department processes, forest clearance, panchayat approvals, and state renewable energy policy requirements.
* Ability to read and interpret land records, revenue maps, survey drawings, village maps, cadastral maps, GIS inputs, project layouts, and transmission alignment drawings.
* Capability to maintain land MIS, approval trackers, issue logs, risk registers, documentation repositories, and management dashboards.
* Commercial awareness on land valuation, negotiation principles, compensation structures, lease rentals, transaction cost, and budgeting for land acquisition.
* Understanding of legal, regulatory, compliance, and governance risks associated with land acquisition and estate management.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Stakeholder Management: Ability to work effectively with landowners, local communities, aggregators, government authorities, internal project teams, and senior leadership.
* Ownership and Accountability: Demonstrates high follow-through, proactive escalation, and commitment to timely land availability for project milestones.
* Negotiation and Influencing: Capable of managing sensitive discussions, building consensus, and resolving conflicts with practical and compliant solutions.
* Planning and Execution: Strong ability to track multiple workstreams, manage priorities, maintain documentation discipline, and drive closure across site and Head Office teams.
* Problem Solving: Able to handle ambiguity, regulatory complexity, site-level resistance, documentation gaps, and operational bottlenecks with a solution-oriented approach.
* Communication: Clear, structured, and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders, including preparation of status updates, review notes, trackers, and escalation summaries.

**Qualifications**
Graduate in any discipline; qualification in Law, Civil Engineering, Land Management, Rural Management, or Business Administration will be preferred.
  
  

* Relevant experience in land acquisition, land liaisoning, Land & Estate, revenue matters, right of way, statutory approvals, or project land management.
* Experience in renewable energy, power, infrastructure, mining, transmission, or large industrial projects will be advantageous.
* Strong local stakeholder network, understanding of regional land practices, and willingness to travel extensively to project sites.

title: Rotating Equipment Project Engineer (Project Lead Engineer)
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
Are you ready to take your engineering career to the next level with Siemens Energy? As a Project Lead Engineer(Rotating Engineer), you will have the outstanding opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects that craft the future of energy. This role is located in India, where you will collaborate with our extraordinary team to deliver outstanding solutions!
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Responsibility for this position: coordinate yourself the technical execution of a few assigned client orders ; striving for execution excellence
* Align with the applicable Project Management Process in place, as well as apply the Company standards regarding Quality and EHS management.
* Use global collaborative tools (SharePoint, Jira, Globus) recommended by COE management for efficient team project management.
* Follow a project leadership approach and not just a catalogue of design recipes: rather than select right away “the best technical solution” when facing critical decisions, compile and submit to the PM scenarii or alternatives that compare as required.
* Technical risk assessment, execution risk for Company, Client benefit, possible impact on project spend & critical path.
* Depend on, and generally follow the design authority held by the relevant engineering team managers or lead engineers (e.g. Core Compressor, Systems, Controls, Package integration), or with the concerned area expert (e.g. rotor dynamics, metallurgy).
* In case of technical recommendations conflicting with each other, evaluate, decide and communicate on the way forward. If important metrics are at risk, recommend a solution to the project manager and Center of Excellence for resolution.
* Upon request of his manager, coach one or a few less experienced REPE(s) through the challenges of their assigned jobs.

**What You Bring**

* BE/B.Tech in mechanical engineering or – other degrees in systems, chemical or fluid dynamics engineering with rotating machinery experience.
* Upto 5 years of experience with industrial equipment, services or projects, among which ideally 2 years responsibilities in relation with rotating equipment for O&G industry in one or several of these functions: product or system engineering, design development, machine testing, installation, commissioning, operation, repair, upgrade.
* Familiar with the functional principles and the associated auxiliary systems (centrifugal compressor; reciprocating compressor; aeroderivative or industrial-type gas turbine; condensation or back-pressure steam turbine; electric machinery)
* Detailed knowledge of system instrumentation and wiring methods, compressor process design, control, and/or dynamic simulation; piping and valving; package layout.
* Application of materials, welding, and coating systems; rotor dynamics; aero-thermodynamic performance calculation; specification of couplings and gearboxes; vibration analysis
* Machinery trouble-shooting; any industry standard relevant for O&G markets (count 1 for each individual standard in libraries like: API, ASME, EU Directives, IEC, CSA, NORSOK, NR, etc..)
* Curious of products and technologies, keen on learning on the fly.
* Proven analytical and communication skills when processing or delivering written and verbal information

division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy.As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. title: Planning Engineer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day!**
To ensure business continuity within the Demand Management unit of Siemens Energy's Compression Global Operations in Naroda, India, this Planning Engineer role is critical for aligning manufacturing capacity with customer demand. The position supports the execution of complex compression system projects by managing production schedules and material requirements. To address these business aims, this role focuses on production scheduling, material demand planning, and cross-functional coordination. These core areas ensure optimal utilization of manufacturing resources and timely delivery of compression packages. Given the focus on demand management and production planning, the ideal candidate will have strong experience in ERP systems (SAP), material requirements planning (MRP), and manufacturing workflows. A background in mechanical engineering or production planning within a heavy engineering or rotating equipment industry is essential.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact.**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize master production schedules (MPS) for compression systems and components.
* Analyze manufacturing capacity constraints and coordinate with workshop managers to resolve bottlenecks.
* Monitor progress of production orders against the baseline schedule and implement corrective actions for delays.
* Execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) runs to ensure timely availability of parts and raw materials.
* Collaborate with procurement and logistics to track critical components and prevent material shortages.
* Optimize inventory levels to balance manufacturing requirements with working capital targets.
* Coordinate with Project Management, Engineering, and Quality departments to align project milestones with manufacturing schedules.
* Prepare and present regular production progress reports, KPIs, and capacity utilization forecasts to management.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives (Lean/Kaizen) to streamline planning processes and reduce lead times.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production, or Industrial Engineering
* 5 to 8 years of experience in production planning, scheduling, or demand management within heavy manufacturing, rotating equipment, or oil & gas sectors.
* The ideal candidate will have strong experience in ERP systems (SAP), material requirements planning (MRP), and manufacturing workflows.
* Master Production Scheduling (MPS). Capacity Planning & Leveling.
* Material Requirements Planning (MRP).
* SAP PP/MM Modules.
* Data Analysis & Reporting (Excel, PowerBI). Understanding of Manufacturing Workflows (Rotating Equipment/Compression Systems).
* Cross-Functional Collaboration. Problem-Solving & Bottleneck Analysis

Our

division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. title: US Tax Manager (1040)
description:
**Position Summary**

The Individual Tax Delivery Lead will be based in India and will serve as the operational and execution leader for MYCPE ONE's offshore Individual Tax delivery team, supporting US individual tax compliance and planning engagements end to end. This individual will oversee day-to-day engagement execution, manage the offshore individual tax team, ensure technical quality and timely delivery, and work in close coordination with the US-based Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.

This is a full-time, salaried leadership position within MYCPE ONE. It does not carry responsibility for client acquisition or closing new CPA firm relationships. The focus is on operational excellence, execution, and delivery, working within engagements that the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead has already secured and scoped.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Delivery Leadership**

* Lead the offshore Individual Tax delivery team supporting US-based clients and CPA firms.
* Own end-to-end execution of assigned individual tax compliance and planning engagements.
* Ensure returns and workpapers are staffed, scheduled, and delivered on time, particularly around federal filing deadlines and extension cycles.
* Implement and maintain SOPs, review checklists, and delivery workflows for individual tax engagements.

**Engagement Execution and Client Servicing**

* Serve as a direct point of contact for end clients on day-to-day individual tax matters.
* Coordinate preparation of Form 1040 and related individual filings, including multi-state and part-year or non-resident returns.
* Respond to client requests for information and resolve routine client queries, including estimated payments and notice-related questions.
* Keep clients and the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead informed of engagement status and open items.

**Technical Review and Quality**

* Review individual tax returns, supporting workpapers, and calculations prepared by the offshore team.
* Apply and enforce IRS regulations, individual tax compliance requirements, and firm methodology across engagements.
* Identify and resolve technical issues at the engagement level, escalating complex individual tax planning or controversy matters to the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.
* Support quality control reviews and consistency of review standards across the individual tax team.

**Onshore Coordination**

* Work closely with the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead on engagement planning and scoping handed off from the US side.
* Provide regular status updates, capacity forecasts, and escalation of risks or delays, particularly during peak filing season.
* Align offshore execution with onshore expectations on quality, timelines, and client communication standards.

**Team Management and Operations**

* Manage, mentor, and develop offshore tax managers, seniors, and preparers focused on individual tax.
* Plan resource allocation and workload distribution across engagements, especially during tax season peaks.
* Monitor engagement metrics such as turnaround time, review points, and rework.
* Drive process improvements and standardization across the individual tax delivery team.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, and training of offshore individual tax staff.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* CPA qualification (active US CPA license preferred) or Enrolled Agent (EA) credential; candidates with a completed CPA and strong US individual tax experience will also be considered.
* Active PTIN (Preparer Tax Identification Number) in good standing with the IRS.
* 12+ years of experience in US individual tax compliance, with a primary focus on Form 1040 preparation and review.
* Experience working within an offshore or global delivery team serving US CPA firms or US clients directly.
* Demonstrated experience managing execution and delivery of individual tax engagements, not limited to preparation or review of individual returns.
* Experience serving as a point of contact for end clients on individual tax matters.
* Experience working in close coordination with an onshore or US-based engagement lead or partner.
* Strong understanding of:
* Individual income tax compliance, including multi-state and non-resident filings
* Individual tax planning, including estimated payments and withholding
* IRS notices, correspondence, and basic resolution processes
* Experience supervising and developing individual tax teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a role dedicated to delivery and operations rather than business development.
* Experience with outsourced or offshored individual tax compliance services.
* Experience with high-net-worth individual clients.
* Experience with individual tax matters tied to pass-through entities, such as K-1 reporting.
* Experience with technology-enabled individual tax preparation and workflow tools.

**Technical Skills**

Experience with one or more of the following:

* Thomson Reuters (UltraTax)
* CCH Axcess / ProSystem fx Tax
* Drake
* Lacerte
* Intuit ProConnect

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first year, the Individual Tax Delivery Lead will:

* Establish a reliable, well-run offshore delivery model for US individual tax engagements.
* Consistently meet filing deadlines and quality benchmarks, including through peak tax season.
* Build a strong, capable offshore individual tax team.
* Operate as a trusted operational counterpart to the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.
* Maintain high client satisfaction on execution and responsiveness.
* Drive measurable improvements in delivery efficiency and process consistency.

**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
Lead the
**engineering and execution of a greenfield biosimilars manufacturing facility**
, covering conceptual design, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, and handover to operations.
  
  
The role will have overall engineering ownership for
**facility, process systems, utilities, equipment, HVAC, automation, electrical, civil/structural, and infrastructure**
, ensuring the project meets approved scope, schedule, CAPEX, GMP, EHS, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Engineering Project Leadership
* Lead all engineering activities for the greenfield biosimilars facility from concept design through commissioning and handover.
* Develop the engineering execution strategy, project organization, deliverables, schedules, and resource requirements.
* Establish and manage engineering scope, budget, schedule, interfaces, risks, and technical deliverables.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams and ensure timely resolution of technical issues.
* Lead technical reviews, design reviews, HAZOP/HAZID, constructability reviews, value engineering, and design optimization.
* Facility & Process Engineering
* Drive development of facility layouts, process flows, material/personnel flows, zoning, segregation, and cleanroom concepts.
* Ensure facility design supports biosimilar manufacturing requirements, including:

+ Upstream processing
+ Downstream processing
+ Buffer/media preparation
+ Formulation
+ Drug substance/drug product areas, as applicable
+ Sampling and dispensing
+ Cold rooms/freezers
+ Warehousing
+ QC laboratories

* Review and approve URS, FRS, process descriptions, PFDs, P&IDs, equipment specifications, and engineering drawings.
* Ensure design incorporates appropriate future expansion and capacity requirements.
* Utilities & Infrastructure

Provide engineering oversight for critical GMP and non-GMP utilities, including:
  
  

* Purified Water / WFI systems
* Clean steam
* Process gases and compressed air
* HVAC and cleanroom systems
* Chilled water and cooling systems
* Boilers and hot-water systems
* Nitrogen and other specialty gases
* Electrical distribution and backup power
* Building management systems
* Effluent and waste-treatment systems
* Fire protection systems
* Plant and site infrastructure
* Equipment Engineering & Procurement
* Lead selection, specification, technical evaluation, and procurement of major process and utility equipment.
* Review vendor proposals and participate in technical bid evaluations.
* Manage equipment design reviews, FAT/SAT, vendor documentation, and installation requirements.
* Ensure equipment selection meets GMP, maintainability, safety, reliability, and lifecycle-cost requirements.
* Coordinate integration of single-use and stainless-steel technologies, as applicable.
* EPC / EPCM & Contractor Management
* Manage EPC/EPCM consultants, engineering contractors, construction contractors, and equipment vendors.
* Review engineering deliverables and ensure compliance with approved design standards.
* Monitor contractor performance against scope, schedule, quality, and cost.
* Lead technical and commercial discussions related to engineering changes and contractor claims.
* Ensure effective interface management between engineering disciplines and construction teams.
* Automation & Digital Systems
* Provide engineering leadership for BMS, EMS, SCADA, DCS/PLC, process automation, and facility monitoring systems.
* Ensure appropriate integration between process equipment and site automation systems.
* Coordinate with IT/CSV teams for computerized-system requirements and GMP compliance.
* Support implementation of data-integrity and electronic-record requirements.
* Construction, Commissioning & Qualification
* Provide engineering leadership throughout construction and installation.
* Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, GMP requirements, and EHS standards.
* Lead construction punch-list closure and technical issue resolution.
* Coordinate commissioning, qualification, and validation activities with CQV, QA, Engineering, and Operations.
* Ensure readiness of systems for IQ/OQ/PQ and process qualification, as applicable.
* Drive engineering handover and preparation of final documentation/as-built drawings.
* GMP & Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure engineering design complies with applicable cGMP, GEP, GxP, EHS, and regulatory requirements.
* Incorporate relevant requirements from US FDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO, PIC/S, ISPE, and applicable local regulations.
* Participate in regulatory inspection preparation and provide engineering support during inspections.
* Ensure appropriate engineering documentation, traceability, change control, and deviation management.
* Project Controls & Governance
* Develop and maintain the engineering master schedule and critical-path activities.
* Track engineering progress, procurement milestones, construction progress, and commissioning readiness.
* Manage engineering CAPEX and identify cost-saving/value-engineering opportunities.
* Establish project KPIs and provide regular reporting to senior management.
* Proactively identify and mitigate technical and execution risks.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**
B.E/ B. Tech (Mechanical/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Instrumentation)

description:
**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
The Site Supply Chain Leader is responsible for leading end-to-end supply chain operations for the Pipan biosimilars drug substance manufacturing site. This role ensures reliable, compliant, and cost-effective material flow to support manufacturing, clinical, and commercial supply requirements.
  
  
The position provides leadership across planning and scheduling, warehouse operations, capacity management, and inventory control, while aligning plant execution with business and global supply chain priorities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Site Supply Chain Leadership
* Lead all site supply chain activities from material receipt to drug substance dispatch.
* Act as the primary supply chain lead for Pipan plant at site and cross-functional governance forums.
* Convert business and global supply requirements into practical site execution plans.
* Ensure supply chain priorities are aligned with manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and procurement functions.
* Planning, Scheduling, and Execution
* Lead production planning and scheduling to ensure smooth execution and optimal use of plant capacity.
* Manage batch schedules in line with manufacturing timelines, material availability, and customer commitments.
* Drive high schedule adherence, on-time batch completion, and right-first-time execution.
* Respond proactively to demand changes, process constraints, and operational disruptions.
* Capacity Management
* Own site capacity planning and scenario analysis for clinical, launch, and commercial programs.
* Work with Manufacturing, MSAT, and Engineering to identify bottlenecks and improve capacity.
* Support scale-up, new product introduction, and process changes from a supply chain perspective.
* Warehouse and Material Management
* Lead GMP warehouse operations covering raw materials, consumables, intermediates, and temperature-controlled storage.
* Ensure compliant material receipt, storage, handling, sampling coordination, segregation, and traceability.
* Oversee inbound and outbound logistics to maintain uninterrupted plant operations.
* Inventory Control
* Own site inventory strategy for raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.
* Balance service levels, inventory health, and working capital requirements.
* Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counts, reconciliation, expiry monitoring, and control processes.
* Drive actions for slow-moving, excess, obsolete, and at-risk inventory.
* Compliance, Quality, and Risk Management
* Ensure all supply chain activities comply with GMP, GDP, EHS, and company standards.
* Support regulatory inspections, internal audits, and quality reviews as the site supply chain representative.
* Identify supply risks proactively and lead mitigation plans related to materials, suppliers, and internal operations.
* Stakeholder Management
* Partner closely with Manufacturing, Quality, MSAT, Regulatory, Procurement, and Global Supply Chain teams.
* Work with external suppliers, logistics partners, and service providers to strengthen supply continuity.
* Team Leadership
* Lead and develop teams across:

+ Planning & Scheduling
+ Warehouse Operations
+ Capacity Management
+ Inventory Control

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Pharmacy, Supply Chain, or related field.
* MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 16–18+ years of progressive supply chain experience in biologics, biosimilars, vaccines, or large-molecule pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Strong experience in site supply chain leadership within GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.
* Good understanding of drug substance manufacturing and batch-process operations.
* Experience supporting clinical to commercial supply transitions is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Site Supply Chain Leadership
* Planning and Capacity Management
* GMP / GDP Compliance Knowledge
* Warehouse and Inventory Management
* Risk Management and Scenario Planning
* Cross-functional Stakeholder Management
* Strong business and financial acumen
* People leadership and team development
* Change management and continuous improvement

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Pharmacy, Supply Chain, or related field.
* MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

 Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and
 





 developing deep large\-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI,
 





 computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction
 





 industry with our innovative AI\-powered construction management solution,
 
**“Kael”** 

 — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with
 





 real\-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform,
 
**“Observance”** 

 , uses LiDAR scanning,
 





 thermal imaging, and AI\-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as\-built
 





 intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.
 





  





**Role Description** 





 We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented
 
**Civil Execution Coordinator** 

 to join our project delivery team. This role is responsible for monitoring on\-site civil works progress, coordinating contractors, and ensuring accurate site data is captured daily in the project management platform — so that progress tracking, resource allocation, and risk forecasting are grounded in real site conditions. The team operates with an AI\-powered project management platform as its primary working tool — all field information must be captured into the platform in real time, and its outputs used to drive delivery. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad.
 









**Responsibilities** 




**Civil Works Execution \& Monitoring** 



* Monitor day\-to\-day progress of civil works including substructure, superstructure, finishes, and external development against the master programme.
* Allocate available resources for critical and scheduled civil works and inform the PSP Project Manager for implementation.
* Coordinate daily site activities across civil contractors, subcontractors, and labour agencies to maintain schedule adherence.
* Identify and escalate schedule deviations, resource shortfalls, and sequencing conflicts to the Project Manager.
* Ensure method statements and risk assessments are prepared, uploaded to the platform, and comply with applicable standards and codal practices.
* Supervise a dedicated close\-out team (where required) to address minor quality defects flagged by the platform or QC inspections.



**Schedule \& Progress Reporting** 



* Update civil progress data, milestone completions, and manpower deployment records in the platform on a daily basis.
* Prepare and maintain level schedule updates; prepare catch\-up plans for any slippages and present to the Project Manager.
* Validate executed quantities against scan\-based outputs from the Observance platform before confirming progress updates.
* Track procurement dependencies for critical civil materials to provide advance warning of potential supply delays.
* Prepare weekly and fortnightly civil progress reports for client and internal review.



**Contractor \& Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Conduct daily site walks and document observations against approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate with quality and safety teams to ensure civil execution meets project standards.
* Attend site review meetings; record and follow up on action items to closure.
* Support preparation of contractor payment documentation, variation logs, and BOQ reconciliations.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 2–5 years of on\-site civil engineering execution experience with a developer, PMC, or main contractor.
* Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering.
* Working knowledge of construction scheduling, BOQ measurement, and site documentation practices.
* Familiarity with digital project management or site reporting tools is an advantage.
* Strong coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple contractors simultaneously.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Project or equivalent scheduling software.



  





**Work Location : Ahmedabad (On\-site)**

title: Electrical Project Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Specmax Technologies Pte Ltd is a Singapore\-based engineering organization established in 2014, serving semiconductor manufacturing, petrochemical, and related industries. The company specializes in complex piping systems, equipment installations such as Chemical Dispensing Systems, Slurry Dispense Systems, and Valve Manifold Boxes, as well as PLC programming, HMI and SCADA design, integration, and maintenance. With extensive experience in project planning, execution, and commissioning of chemical, slurry, and gas systems for semiconductor facilities, Specmax has successfully completed numerous projects over its years of operation. The company also delivers cost\-effective design solutions, including calculations, drawings, fabrication, and installation for both greenfield and brownfield projects.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Electrical Project Engineer role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Ahmedabad. The role involves designing and reviewing electrical systems for semiconductor and related industrial projects, ensuring compliance with safety standards and local regulations. The Electrical Project Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop power distribution layouts, support equipment installations, and coordinate with vendors and contractors. Daily responsibilities include preparing technical documentation, assisting in project planning and scheduling, monitoring project progress, and participating in testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of electrical systems. The role also requires contributing to cost\-effective solutions, supporting maintenance activities, and continuously improving electrical design and project execution practices.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Electrical Engineering, with practical knowledge of electricity and industrial electrical systems.
* Proficiency in Electrical Design and related tools for industrial, semiconductor, or process\-based facilities.
* Experience with Power Systems and Power Distribution, including load calculations, protection coordination, and panel design.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, and specifications, and prepare clear engineering documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Experience in industrial or semiconductor projects, preferably involving complex piping, equipment installations, or automation systems.
* Knowledge of relevant electrical codes, standards, and safety regulations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and quality.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional teams, contractors, and clients.
* Ability to work on\-site in Ahmedabad and manage multiple tasks in a project\-driven environment.

title: Lead – Corporate Business Excellence
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Business Excellence:** 
 Our Business Excellence Department drives operational transformation across Adani’s portfolio by integrating process optimization, digitalization, and best practices. Using cutting\-edge analytics and lean methodologies, we streamline operations to boost efficiency, quality, and sustainable growth. By fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaborating with internal teams and external partners, we implement strategic initiatives that maximize resource utilization and set new standards in operational excellence.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead is responsible for driving the adoption and execution of process assurance and operational excellence solutions across the organization. This role focuses on ensuring the business optimizes its processes and reduces inefficiencies through solutions like CWS, SPS, and BPR. The BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead will track performance metrics, standardize processes, and implement best practices that improve quality, compliance, and overall business performance. This role will work cross\-functionally to ensure that the organization is continuously improving, achieving operational goals, and reducing risks.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead**
**Process Improvement \& Digital Transformation**
 Lead continuous process improvement through Challenges Worth Solving (CWS), Structured Problem Solving (SPS), and BPR initiatives.
   

  

 Enhance automation, reduce manual errors, and improve operational efficiency by implementing digital transformation strategies.
   

  

 Streamline operations, reduce waste, and improve interdepartmental efficiency by leading cross\-functional projects.
   

  

**Performance Metrics \& Reporting**
 Ensure measurable improvements by defining and tracking performance metrics aligned with business objectives.
   

  

 Drive performance improvements and support business goals by implementing and regularly updating the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) for BUs.
   

  

**Process Governance \& Standardization**
 Improve process consistency and quality by developing and enforcing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
   

  

 Ensure compliance with ISO and quality standards, driving best practices in process governance.
   

  

**Training \& Capability Building**
 Enhance process knowledge and operational skills across teams by leading training initiatives.
   

  

 Support ongoing operational excellence by establishing the Adani Business Excellence Academy (ABEA) and a process assurance mechanism.
   

  

**Institutionalise The Adani Business Excellence Academy**
 Create a Virtual organisation Adani Business Excellence Academy which would be responsible for promoting the Business Excellence Roadmap across all BUs through ensuring focussed training \& development, monitoring of the Business Excellence activities \& their KPIs, promotion of BE roadmap through communication and appropriate R\&R
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Business Unit Heads (Energy, Ports, etc.)
   

  

 Adani Workforce Management System (AWMS)
   

  

 Adani Business Excellence Academy (ABEA)
   

  

 Operations Department
   

  

 Human Resources (HR) and Learning \& Development Department
   

  

 Finance Department
   

  

 Compliance Department
   

  

 Data Analytics Department
   

  

 Information Technology (IT) Department
   

  

 Senior Leadership (CXOs, CEO)
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Industry Benchmarking Bodies
   

  

 External Consultants and Partners
   

  

 Regulatory Authorities
   

  

 Vendors and Technology Providers
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Conduct Business Excellence Maturity Assessments
* Liaise with Business Excellence Heads/ SPOCs in various BUs to conduct self\-assessment based on Business Excellence Maturity Assessment toolkit.
* Coordinate and organize the on\-site assessment of BUs which have undertaken self\-assessment through external assessment partner.
* Coordinate and facilitate the completion of BEx Maturity assessment report with external assessment partner
* Review the BEx Maturity assessment report and get it approved with senior BE leaders and handing over to the respective BU CEO
* Organization of action planning workshop in the respective BU through external assessment partner.
* Track and coordinate with respective BU BEx Heads to ensure timely closure of action items, drive them to logical conclusions, and monitor the realization of intended business benefits and impact.
* Identification, Capability building and certification of BU\-wise Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)
* Liaise with Business Excellence Heads/SPOCs in various BUs to identify Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in each of their key functions.
* Coordinate with external training partners and certification bodies to deliver capability\-building certification programs to develop and certify SMEs in alignment to their business needs.
* Manage end\-to\-end logistics, nominations, attendance, assessments, certifications, and program effectiveness reviews of these training programs.
* Review, monitor and track progress of improvement projects undertaken by training participants/SMEs, ensuring timely completion and benefit realization.
* Utilization of SMEs to undertake L\&D sessions for organization development
* Enable and guide SMEs to further conduct training and improvement initiatives within their businesses/functions, ensuring effective deployment of methodologies such as QC Tools, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and process Management, and monitoring the resulting business impact and benefits realization.
* Develop a strong network of such SMEs capable of independently conducting training and driving improvement initiatives within their functions and businesses.


**Qualifications**
**Skills and Educational Qualification:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Certification in Lean or Six Sigma methodologies is preferred
+ Certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt
+ Project \& Program management skills

8. Drive implementation of Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, ensuring compliance with applicable GMP, GLP, regulatory guidelines, and company procedures.
9. Review and approve SOPs, BMRs, protocols, reports, change controls, deviations, CAPAs, risk assessments, and other quality documents related to process development activities.
10. Ensure availability of raw materials, consumables, resins, chemicals, standards, and reagents required for uninterrupted execution of development activities.
11. Manage laboratory inventories and material consumption, ensuring proper stock control, storage conditions, and timely procurement.
12. Oversee maintenance, calibration, qualification, and operation of laboratory and pilot\-scale equipment in accordance with cGMP and EHS requirements.
13. Ensure compliance with Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) policies, promoting a strong safety culture and ensuring safe laboratory practices.
14. Lead root cause investigations, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process performance, productivity, and product quality.
15. Assess and implement new technologies, purification platforms, and process innovations to improve development efficiency and manufacturing capabilities.
16. Train, mentor, and supervise scientific staff and junior team members, ensuring competency development, knowledge sharing, and high\-performance teamwork.
17. Support project planning, resource allocation, and milestone tracking to ensure timely achievement of development objectives.
18. Ensure successful execution of vaccine development programs from proof\-of\-concept through process validation and commercialization stages.

* Vaccine Process Development (DSP)
* Chromatography and Filtration Technologies
* Conjugate Vaccine Development

* GMP \& Regulatory Compliance

* Risk Assessment and Problem Solving

title: Creative Account Manager
description:
**Creative Account Manager** 




 Because — Ahmedabad · Full\-time · On\-site
 



  





 We're
 **Because** 
 — an AI\-native brand and marketing agency working across education, real estate, lifestyle, sports and financial services. This role is for someone who is genuinely two things at once: sharp enough to run client relationships, and creative enough to do the actual work. You'll own 4–6 accounts, report directly to a senior strategist, and be expected to think, write, plan, coordinate, and execute — often on the same day. If that sounds exhausting rather than exciting, this probably isn't the right fit.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* Manage 3–4 client accounts end\-to\-end — timelines, feedback cycles, approvals, and proactive communication. Clients should never have to follow up with you.
* Develop content strategy and campaign concepts — not just execute briefs, but help shape what the brief should be in the first place.
* Write copy across formats — social captions, scripts, brand messaging, ad copy, emailers — in English, Hindi, or Gujarati depending on the client.
* Build client presentations and strategy decks that make a clear argument and hold the room.
* Contribute to pitches — own your section, know the prospect's business, and present with conviction.
* Plan and coordinate shoots — brief photographers and videographers, prepare shot lists and call sheets, manage on\-ground logistics, and ensure the output matches the creative vision.
* Write scripts for reels, brand films, ads, and talking\-head content — punchy, platform\-aware, and on\-brief.
* Reference and brief designers and video editors with enough visual and tonal direction that they don't have to guess what you want.
* Manage social media hands\-on for select clients — content calendars, scheduling, captions, and community responses.
* Coordinate with external vendors — studios, talent, print vendors, photographers — and hold them to timelines and quality standards.



  





**You're a fit if** 



* You have 3–4 years at a creative or marketing agency and you've genuinely done both sides — not just one with a footnote of the other.
* You can write in at least two of the three: English, Hindi, Gujarati. Fluency in all three is a real advantage here.
* You can hold a client conversation in the morning, brief a designer at noon, review a script by evening, and not mix up which client is which.
* Your strategy thinking is grounded — you back ideas with audience insight, not just instinct.
* You've been on set. You know what a shot list is, how to manage a photographer who runs late, and what "we'll fix it in post" actually costs.
* You use AI tools actively — for copy drafts, research, referencing, strategy frameworks — and you've built your own workflow around them.
* You push back on bad briefs and bad ideas — politely, with reasoning — rather than just executing whatever lands in your inbox.
* Nothing falls through the cracks on your accounts. Not because someone's checking, but because that's just how you work.



  





  





**Work samples are mandatory.** 
 Share a deck you built, copy you wrote, a campaign you managed, or a shoot you coordinated.

title: Civil Engineer (Techno Commercial)
description:
**Company Description** 
 NBP Nirmaan Bharat Panels LLP (NBP) is an innovation\-driven construction materials company focused on solving challenges associated with traditional building systems. Rooted in a passion for technology and green building solutions, NBP develops and delivers advanced materials that support faster, sustainable construction. Its flagship product, Reinforced EPS Structural Panels (RESP), is recognized in the corporate and construction sectors as a key reference for high\-quality, efficient building solutions. Backed by research from government and leading technical agencies such as BMPTC, IIT Roorkee, PWD, and global organizations, NBP provides RESP panels in various sizes and specifications to meet diverse architectural needs. The company’s solutions aim to reduce construction time, cost, CO2 emissions, and energy usage while meeting India’s growing urban housing demand.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Civil Engineer (Techno Commercial) role based in Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar (Gujarat) . The role involves designing and reviewing structural solutions using Reinforced EPS Structural Panels (RESP), preparing technical drawings and reports, and ensuring compliance with relevant codes and standards. The Civil Engineer will coordinate with sales and business teams to provide techno\-commercial support, including cost estimates, proposals, and technical presentations to clients and stakeholders. Daily responsibilities include project planning, site visits, monitoring construction activities, and collaborating with architects, contractors, and government agencies to ensure quality, safety, and timely delivery. The role also includes supporting product optimization, assisting in trials and demonstrations, and contributing to the documentation and promotion of NBP’s green building technologies.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess skills in Civil Engineering and Civil Engineering Design for structural analysis, detailing, and construction methodologies.
* Candidates should possess skills related to Planning to manage project timelines, resources, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess skills in Stormwater Management to support sustainable site design and compliance with environmental and drainage requirements.
* Candidates should be qualified Civil Engineers with a strong understanding of building materials, codes, and standards relevant to green and fast\-track construction.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Civil Engineering or a closely related field.
* Experience in building construction projects, preferably with innovative or prefabricated systems.
* Ability to interpret architectural and structural drawings, prepare BOQs, and support cost estimations.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and clients.
* Proficiency with CAD or similar design tools and basic project management software.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively on\-site and adapt to a fast\-paced, innovation\-focused environment.

 We are seeking a seasoned engineering leader to join us as Deputy General Manager (DGM) – Engineering for our flagship high\-rise developments. This role is pivotal in driving end\-to\-end project execution, ensuring excellence in construction, adherence to timelines, and alignment with quality and safety standards.

The incumbent will bring strong technical acumen, leadership capability, and cross\-functional coordination to deliver complex developments with precision and efficiency.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Planning \& Execution** 



* Lead the development and execution of comprehensive project plans, ensuring alignment with business objectives and project milestones.
* Drive project scheduling, resource planning, and milestone tracking across all phases of construction.
* Ensure timely delivery within approved budgets and defined quality benchmarks.
* Oversee construction methodologies, technical planning, and execution strategies for high\-rise developments.



**2\. Site Management \& Supervision** 



* Oversee all on\-site engineering and construction activities, ensuring seamless coordination across project teams.
* Ensure strict adherence to approved drawings, design specifications, construction methodologies, safety protocols, and quality standards.
* Collaborate effectively with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Monitor critical construction activities, including structural works, vertical transportation, façade installation, and finishing.



**3\. Budgeting \& Cost Control** 



* Manage project budgets and monitor cost performance against approved estimates.
* Drive cost optimisation initiatives while maintaining the required quality and technical standards.
* Review and approve contractor bills, BOQs, and variation claims in accordance with delegated authority.
* Identify opportunities for improving productivity, resource utilisation, and overall project cost efficiency.



**4\. Quality \& Safety Compliance** 



* Establish and enforce robust quality assurance and quality control frameworks.
* Implement and monitor safety standards, site inspections, and audit mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, environmental, and construction regulations.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions to address construction quality issues and site risks.



**5\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead vendor selection, technical evaluation, and contractor performance management.
* Build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and relevant authorities.
* Proactively resolve site\-level challenges, technical bottlenecks, and project escalations.
* Ensure effective coordination between engineering, procurement, planning, and project management teams.



**6\. Reporting \& Governance** 



* Present periodic MIS reports on project progress, cost performance, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Identify project risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Lead project review meetings with internal teams and senior leadership.
* Establish effective project monitoring systems and ensure accountability across execution teams.



**Candidate Profile** 



* Experience: 18\+ years of experience in engineering and construction, preferably within the real estate development sector.
* High\-Rise Project Experience: Must have successfully completed at least 2 high\-rise projects, each with a minimum height of 150 metres.
* Leadership Experience: Minimum 8 years in a senior leadership role managing large\-scale residential and/or commercial developments.
* Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of high\-rise construction, structural engineering, project planning, execution methodologies, and construction management.
* Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Civil Engineering.
* Project Delivery: Proven track record of delivering complex, large\-scale developments with strong execution, cost control, quality, and safety outcomes.
* Leadership \& Coordination: Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage consultants, contractors, and senior stakeholders.



*Mandatory Selection Criterion* 



* Candidates must have direct experience in the successful completion and delivery of a minimum of two high\-rise projects, each at least 150 metres in height.
