title: Plant & Machinery (P&M) Mechanical Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose / Description**
 The P\&M Mechanical Engineer owns end\-to\-end mechanical engineering for the project's plant \& machinery fleet, principally Tower Cranes, Batching Plants, Concrete Pumps, Boom Placers (Static/Mobile), Passenger\-cum\-Material Hoists and Telehandlers — the major P\&M asset categories deployed on project, along with the wider spread of earthmoving, material\-handling and site\-support equipment, and additionally owns the mechanical/piping scope of Site Enabling Services — temporary water supply, plumbing and drainage infrastructure. The role spans the full equipment lifecycle — pre\-mobilization technical evaluation, installation, commissioning, operation support, maintenance, overhaul and eventual demobilization/redeployment — with accountability for maximizing equipment uptime, safety and cost efficiency across the project.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Conduct pre\-mobilization technical evaluation and site\-suitability assessment of equipment — foundation/ground bearing capacity, approach and clearances — before deployment.
* Plan and supervise equipment mobilization, positioning, erection and commissioning sequences as per OEM guidelines, GA drawings and approved method statements.
* Interpret and apply load charts, structural drawings and rigging plans to plan safe lifting operations.
* Plan and execute mast climbing/telescoping sequences for tower cranes and mast\-based equipment in coordination with structural and safety teams.
* Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and structural faults across the equipment fleet.
* Design and drive preventive and predictive maintenance regimes — including condition\-based monitoring such as vibration or oil analysis where applicable — to reduce unplanned downtime.
* Plan and execute major overhauls, critical component change\-outs (engines, gearboxes, wire ropes, hydraulic cylinders) and end\-of\-life refurbishment decisions.
* Evaluate and decide on hire\-versus\-own equipment deployment based on project duration, utilization and lifecycle cost.
* Negotiate and manage OEM/vendor AMC and repair contracts, and monitor service\-level and turnaround performance.
* Coordinate statutory third\-party inspection, periodic load testing and certification renewal of lifting equipment.
* Plan and commission temporary water supply infrastructure — storage, pumping and distribution networks — sized to project consumption.
* Oversee pipe\-laying, jointing, pressure testing and commissioning of plumbing systems, and plan temporary sanitation/drainage infrastructure.
* Monitor fuel and consumable consumption across the fleet and drive efficiency and cost\-control initiatives.
* Plan equipment demobilization, redeployment across clusters and disposal of surplus or obsolete assets.
* Lead root\-cause analysis for repeat equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive safety compliance for mechanical operations — permit\-to\-work, lock\-out/tag\-out, working\-at\-height and lifting\-operation protocols — and lead technical training for mechanical technicians and operators.


****Requirement / Competencies / Qualifications****
 Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 3 years of hands\-on field experience on construction plant \& machinery (higher experience welcome for senior positions), ideally with exposure to tower cranes, hoists, batching plants, concrete pumps, boom placers or telehandlers, along with familiarity with temporary water supply/plumbing systems.
   

  

* Sound understanding of engine, transmission, hydraulic and pneumatic system design and operating principles.
* Working knowledge of the structural and mechanical design aspects of cranes, hoists and mast\-climbing equipment — stability, ballast and tie\-in requirements.
* Familiarity with statutory and regulatory frameworks governing lifting equipment — competent\-person certification, periodic testing and factory/labour regulations.
* Knowledge of preventive/predictive maintenance methodologies and condition\-monitoring techniques.
* Commercial acumen for equipment cost evaluation, contract negotiation and lifecycle cost analysis.
* Understanding of water supply network design principles, pump hydraulics and piping standards.
* Analytical and root\-cause problem\-solving ability for recurring technical failures.
* Ability to read and apply engineering drawings, GA drawings and OEM technical manuals.

title: Historian & IT-OT Functional Manager (Manufacturing Function – IT)
description:
We are looking for a Historian \& IT\-OT Functional Manager who will serve as the
 **voice of manufacturing within the IT organization** 
 . The role is the bridge between plant operations and technology.
 



  





**Job Description:** 




**Role: Historian \& IT\-OT Functional Manager (Manufacturing Function – IT)** 




**Designation: Manager** 




**Experience:** 
 12–18 years total, with at least 6 years in pharmaceutical manufacturing operations or manufacturing IT/OT, and at least 4 years in a functional lead or manager role
 



**Education:** 
 B. Pharm, M. Pharm/ B. E, M.E / B. Tech, M.Tech \- Chemical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines.
 



**Location** 
 : Ahmedabad (The position follows plant operating schedules and a 6\-day working week.)
 



  





**Role Summary:** 
 The ideal candidate has
 **worked in or closely with pharma manufacturing** 
 , understands unit operations, batch lifecycle, equipment, and shop\-floor workflows, and also understands how historians, automation, MES, LIMS, and ERP integrate. The individual will own the functional side of historian and IT\-OT solutions from requirement to go\-live and beyond, working with architects, developers, system integrators, and site teams. Also, will understand how the plant runs, translate manufacturing and quality needs into clear IT and OT requirements, and lead implementation through to adoption and measurable business value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Manufacturing Business Partnering** 



* Act as the primary IT point of contact for Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams at plant and corporate levels.
* Understand plant priorities such as throughput, yield, right\-first\-time, batch cycle time, deviation reduction, compliance, and cost, and align IT\-OT initiatives to them.
* Spend regular time on the shop floor to observe processes, identify pain points, and uncover digital opportunities.
* Build trusted relationships with plant heads, production managers, QA heads, and engineering leads.
* Maintain a prioritized demand backlog and business\-aligned roadmap for historian and IT\-OT solutions.



**2\. Business\-to\-IT Requirement Translation** 



* Lead requirement workshops with manufacturing and quality stakeholders to capture business needs, current\-state (as\-is) processes, and desired future state (to\-be).
* Map manufacturing processes end to end, for example process order release, material dispensing, batch execution, in\-process checks, equipment cleaning and status, batch record review, and batch release.
* Translate business needs into structured deliverables:
 **business requirements, User Requirement Specifications (URS), functional specifications (FS), use cases, user stories, process flows, data mapping, and acceptance criteria** 
 .
* Conduct fit\-gap analysis against standard product capabilities and recommend configuration over customization wherever possible.
* Define which process parameters, alarms, events, and batch context need to be captured, contextualized, and reported, and why they matter to the business.
* Clearly explain technical constraints, options, and trade\-offs back to business users in plain language.



**3\. Historian Functional Ownership** 



* Own the functional design of the process historian (e.g., AVEVA PI System, AspenTech IP.21, Honeywell PHD, Proficy) across sites.
* Define with process and engineering teams which tags, critical process parameters (CPPs), critical quality attributes (CQAs), and utilities data must be collected.
* Drive the design of asset hierarchies, templates, batch and event frames, and calculations based on actual equipment and process structure (ISA\-88 / ISA\-95\).
* Specify dashboards, trends, reports, and alerts for production, QA, engineering, and management users.
* Enable business use cases such as:
* Batch trending and golden batch comparison
* Continued Process Verification (CPV) and Annual Product Quality Review (APQR) data support
* Deviation and investigation support with process data
* OEE, downtime, and equipment performance
* Environmental monitoring (HVAC, cleanrooms, differential pressure, temperature, humidity)
* Utilities and energy monitoring (WFI, purified water, steam, compressed air, HVAC)
* Cold chain and storage condition monitoring



**4\. IT\-OT Integration Functional Leadership** 



* Define functional requirements for integration between shop\-floor systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA, BMS, EMS, standalone equipment) and enterprise systems (MES, LIMS, ERP/SAP, QMS, CMMS, WMS).
* Specify business data flows, for example process order download from SAP to MES, material consumption and goods movement back to ERP, equipment status to MES, process data to eBR, and results from LIMS to batch release.
* Work with the IT\-OT Integration Architect and Historian Architect to confirm that technical designs meet business needs.
* Ensure consistent master data and naming across equipment, materials, recipes, and sites.
* Support Pharma 4\.0 initiatives including analytics, AI/ML use cases, digital twins, and predictive maintenance by clearly defining business context and data needs.



**5\. Implementation and Delivery Ownership** 



* Lead the functional workstream of historian and IT\-OT projects from initiation through design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Plan functional activities, milestones, resources, and dependencies in coordination with project managers, architects, and system integrators.
* Guide developers and integrators on business logic, configuration, and process understanding.
* Lead
 **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** 
 : prepare test scenarios with business users, coordinate execution, and track defects to closure.
* Prepare cutover and go\-live plans with site teams, carefully planning around production schedules, campaigns, and shutdowns.
* Provide hypercare support after go\-live and ensure smooth handover to support teams.
* Manage scope changes through a structured change request process.



**6\. GxP Compliance, Validation and Data Integrity** 



* Ensure all solutions meet
 **21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, and ALCOA\+** 
 requirements.
* Author or own functional validation documents: URS, FS, functional risk assessments, requirements traceability matrix, UAT/PQ protocols, and validation summary inputs.
* Work closely with QA and CSV teams on validation strategy, including CSA risk\-based approaches.
* Ensure changes follow site change control, impact assessment, and periodic review processes.
* Represent historian and IT\-OT systems during regulatory inspections and audits (USFDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO\-GMP, and local authorities), explaining business use and data flows.



**7\. Change Management, Training and Adoption** 



* Drive user adoption through training programs, SOP updates, work instructions, and user guides.
* Identify and develop super\-users and site champions.
* Collect user feedback after go\-live and drive continuous improvements.
* Track and report business benefits and value realization, such as reduced investigation time, improved OEE, and reduced manual data collection.



**8\. Operations and Continuous Improvement** 



* Act as the functional escalation point for historian and IT\-OT application issues.
* Work with support teams on incident, problem, and change management, and help define business\-aligned SLAs.
* Periodically review system usage and data quality with site teams.
* Standardize solutions and templates across sites to support faster, consistent rollouts.



**9\. Team and Vendor Leadership** 



* Lead and mentor functional analysts and business analysts within the manufacturing IT team.
* Manage system integrators and vendors on functional scope, quality, and timelines.
* Coordinate with global and site IT, OT, automation, cybersecurity, and quality teams.



  





**Required Manufacturing Knowledge** 




 The candidate must have solid, practical understanding of:
 


* **Pharma manufacturing types:** 
 API (chemical synthesis), oral solid dosage (OSD), sterile/injectables, and/or biologics.
* **Unit operations and equipment** 
 , for example dispensing, granulation (RMG, FBD), blending, compression, coating, capsule filling, packaging, reactors, centrifuges, dryers, distillation, filtration, fermentation, chromatography, lyophilization, and aseptic filling, depending on site type.
* **Batch lifecycle:** 
 process order, recipe, BMR/BPR and eBR, in\-process controls, equipment cleaning and status logs, yield reconciliation, batch record review, and batch release.
* **Plant utilities and environment:** 
 HVAC, cleanroom classification, WFI/PW systems, clean steam, compressed air, and environmental monitoring.
* **Quality processes:** 
 deviations, CAPA, change control, OOS/OOT, APQR, and CPV.
* **Maintenance and engineering processes:** 
 calibration, preventive maintenance, equipment qualification, and breakdown management.
* **Manufacturing KPIs:** 
 OEE, yield, cycle time, right\-first\-time, downtime, and batch throughput.



  





**Required Technical and Functional Skills** 



* Strong functional knowledge of process historians, preferably
 **AVEVA PI System** 
 (PI AF, Event Frames, PI Vision).
* Working understanding of automation systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA) such as Emerson DeltaV, Siemens PCS 7/WinCC, Rockwell, or ABB.
* Functional understanding of
 **MES** 
 (Körber PAS\-X, Emerson Syncade, Siemens Opcenter),
 **LIMS** 
 (LabWare, LabVantage, Empower),
 **SAP** 
 (PP\-PI, QM, PM, MM), and QMS platforms (e.g., TrackWise, Veeva QMS).
* Knowledge of ISA\-95, ISA\-88, and basic integration concepts (OPC UA/DA, interfaces, APIs, data flows).
* Strong business analysis skills: process mapping (BPMN/Visio), requirement elicitation, fit\-gap analysis, user stories, and UAT management.
* Hands\-on experience delivering and validating GxP computerized systems.
* Familiarity with project delivery methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, hybrid) and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or HP ALM.
* Basic data skills (Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar) to analyze and validate manufacturing data.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in
 **Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Instrumentation, or Mechanical/Electrical Engineering** 
 ; an MBA or IT qualification is a plus.
* Prior experience working
 **in a plant role** 
 (production, engineering, automation, or QA) before moving into IT is highly valued.
* Certifications such as AVEVA/OSIsoft PI, CBAP/PMI\-PBA, PMP/PRINCE2, ITIL, Six Sigma, or Lean.
* Experience with multi\-site or global rollouts and Pharma 4\.0 or digital manufacturing programs.

title: Optical Engineer – IOL Design
description:
**Role Objective:** 




 A key objective of this role is to lead the Optical Engineering team in IOL optical design, IOL power calculation and design\-file documentation, ensuring technical accuracy, completeness and compliance with applicable ISO standards.
 



  





 The role is responsible for providing technical support to IOL Production, reviewing and approving power calculations and design files, overseeing IOL power calculation tools (web and mobile), maintaining audit\-ready ISO compliance records, and supporting CAPA and root\-cause investigations related to optical engineering.
 



  





 The position will serve as the primary technical liaison with cross\-functional teams, international customers, external partners, clinicians and academic institutions, and will contribute to resource planning and development of the Optical Engineering team.
 



  





**Desired Candidate Profile:** 




**Education** 




**Minimum:** 




 B.E./B.Tech or M.Tech/M.S. in:
 


* Optics / Optical Engineering
* Physics



**Desirable:** 



* Prior exposure to ophthalmic devices, particularly Intraocular Lenses (IOLs).



  





**Experience Requirement** 




**Minimum:** 



* Relevant experience in optical design / optical engineering.



**Desirable:** 



* Experience in IOL design, IOL power calculation or ophthalmic medical\-device development.
* Experience in mentoring or supervising junior engineers and trainees.
* Exposure to working with cross\-functional teams in a regulated medical\-device environment.



  





**Role Requirements** 



* Working knowledge of ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 11979 series and ISO 14971\.
* Experience in design\-file documentation, traceability and maintenance of audit\-ready records under a Quality Management System.
* Exposure to CAPA, non\-conformance and root\-cause investigations.
* Strong technical documentation and report\-writing skills.



  





**Role \& Responsibilities:** 



1. Lead and supervise the Optical Engineering team, comprising Optical Engineers and trainees, in IOL optical design, power calculation and design\-file documentation activities, including work allocation and review of technical output for accuracy and completeness.
2. Provide theoretical and technical support to cross\-functional teams, including IOL Production, for the resolution of product\- and process\-related issues, and escalate unresolved technical matters with recommended corrective actions.
3. Identify and interpret applicable ISO standards (ISO 11979 series, ISO 13485 and ISO 14971\), and ensure that the team’s design and documentation practices remain aligned with current requirements.
4. Review and approve IOL power calculations prepared for cross\-functional teams, ensuring accuracy and adherence to agreed turnaround times for customer\-facing requests.
5. Review and approve design\-file documentation for IOL models prior to submission, ensuring traceability and completeness in line with the Quality Management System, and oversee the filing of ISO compliance records so that documentation remains audit\-ready at all times.
6. Act as the primary technical liaison with cross\-functional teams, coordinating technical inputs for regulatory submissions and project\-related decisions.
7. Manage the development and execution of R\&D protocols for international customers, including protocol review, data interpretation and technical reporting.
8. Guide and review the design of new IOL models using Zemax or equivalent optical\-design software, mentor engineers on optical\-design methodology, and validate design outputs.
9. Direct the development and enhancement of IOL power calculation tools across web and mobile platforms, in coordination with software/IT teams, including definition of functional and validation requirements.
10. Establish and oversee a schedule for regular verification of the IOL power calculation tools, ensuring that verification records are maintained and discrepancies are investigated and resolved.
11. Ensure timely preparation and updating of user manuals and documentation for the IOL power calculation tools, for both customers and internal stakeholders.
12. Coordinate technical support for optical instruments, including troubleshooting, calibration oversight and liaison with instrument vendors.
13. Serve as a key point of contact between the organization and external industries/partners for technical support and technical service matters.
14. Build and maintain professional relationships with doctors, universities and optical engineers to support clinical collaboration, technology evaluation and business development.
15. Support technology transfer and IP/collaboration agreements (e.g. with external inventors and clinical collaborators) from a technical due\-diligence perspective.
16. Contribute to CAPA, non\-conformance and root\-cause investigations related to IOL design and optical engineering, and track corrective and preventive actions through to closure.
17. Support resource planning, training plans and performance inputs for the Optical Engineering team.
18. Maintain high standards of professional conduct and hygiene within the team, in keeping with the requirements of a medical\-device manufacturing environment.



  





**Functional Skills Required** 



* In\-depth knowledge of IOL optical design and IOL power calculation methodology.
* Proficiency in Zemax or equivalent optical\-design software.
* Knowledge of verification and lifecycle management of IOL power calculation tools (web and mobile).
* Technical support, troubleshooting and calibration coordination for optical instruments.



  





**Behavioral Skills Required** 



* Supervision, coaching and mentoring of junior engineers and trainees.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Clear written and verbal communication with internal and international stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional coordination and relationship\-building skills.
* High ownership and accountability for accuracy and turnaround times.
* Commitment to quality, compliance and high professional standards.



  





**Team Size to be Handled:** 



* Optical Engineers and trainees within the Optical Engineering team.

description:

 **Business Analyst – BI \& AI**

 **BI, AI, data visualization, and productivity tools**

 **Product, Development, QA, UI/UX, Support, Sales, and Business teams**

+ Business Requirement Documents (BRD)

+ User Stories
+ Acceptance Criteria
+ Process Flows / Workflows

* Support creation of business dashboards and management reports.
* Analyze existing reports and recommend improvements based on business requirements.
* Validate data accuracy between source systems, reports, and dashboards.



**AI \& Productivity Tools** 
  




* Explore and utilize
 **AI tools** 
 to improve requirement analysis, documentation, data analysis, reporting, and productivity.
* Use AI\-assisted tools for:
+ Requirement analysis
+ User Story creation
+ Documentation
+ Data analysis
+ Report/dashboard ideation
+ Process optimization

* Stay updated with emerging
 **AI, BI, analytics, and automation tools** 
 .
* Identify practical opportunities where AI can improve business processes and product capabilities.



**Cross\-Functional Coordination** 
  




* Coordinate effectively with Product, Development, QA, UI/UX, Sales, Support, and other departments.

* Clarify requirements and resolve functional ambiguities during development and testing.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement walkthroughs, UAT, and product demonstrations.

**Product \& Process Analysis** 
  




* Study existing product workflows and identify improvement opportunities.
* Analyze business processes and suggest process optimization.
* Identify functional gaps and translate them into product enhancement requirements.
* Support product teams in defining new features and improving existing functionality.
* Ensure requirements are aligned with business objectives and end\-user expectations.





  





**3\. Required Skills** 
  





**Must Have** 
  




* 1\+ year of experience as a
 **Business Analyst / Product Analyst / Functional Analyst / BI Analyst** 
 .
* Strong understanding of business analysis concepts and requirement gathering.
* Good knowledge of
 **BRD, FRD, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and process documentation** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of data and business reporting.
* Hands\-on exposure to at least one BI / visualization tool such as:
+ Power BI
+ Tableau
+ Similar BI platforms

* Basic to intermediate knowledge of
 **Databases** 
 .
* Good understanding of databases and data structures.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams.



**Preferred** 
  




* Exposure to
 **AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Lovable, or similar tools** 
 .
* Experience using AI for business analysis, documentation, data analysis, or productivity.
* Knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
* Good understanding of REST APIs and JSON.
* Understanding of Agile / Scrum methodology.
* Experience working with Gitlab or similar project management tools.
* Experience in enterprise software/product development.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX and application workflows.



**4\. Key Competencies** 
  




* Business \& Functional Analysis
* Analytical Thinking
* Data Interpretation
* BI \& Dashboard Development
* AI Tool Adoption
* Requirement Documentation
* Problem Solving
* Process Understanding
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Coordination
* Communication Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Product Thinking



**5\. Educational Qualification** 
  




* Bachelor's degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field** 
 .
* Additional certification in
 **Business Analysis, BI, Data Analytics, or AI** 
 will be an advantage.



**6\. What We Expect From the Candidate** 
  





 The candidate should be able to independently take a requirement from:
   





**Business Requirement → Requirement Analysis → BRD/FRD → User Stories → Development Clarification → QA/UAT Support → Business Validation** 
  





 At the same time, the candidate should be able to work with business data and BI tools to:
   





**Data → Analysis → Insight → Dashboard/Report → Business Decision** 
  





 The ideal candidate is therefore not only a documentation\-focused BA, but someone who can
 **understand the business, analyze data, leverage AI tools, and work closely with technology teams to deliver practical product solutions.** 
  





**7\. Experience** 
  





**Preferred:** 
 1–3 years
   





 Candidates with strong analytical skills, good BI/AI tool exposure, and excellent requirement/documentation capabilities may be considered even if their experience is slightly below the preferred range.

title: Mechanical Product Design Engineering - Senior Professional (P3)
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
* The Packaging / System Engineer – holds Engineering knowledge and experience in the application and execution of process and mechanical systems used in Reciprocating Compressors, Integrally Geared Centrifugal Compressor for Industrial Applications. As a rotating equipment projects lead, he will collaborate with an interdisciplinary engineering team from sales handover to project completion, installation, testing, and warranty phases. The Packaging engineer possesses good analytical abilities, detailed problem\-solving skills, and should be hard\-working to overcome all obstacles, whether internal or external.


**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Handle the mechanical systems technical scope for rotating equipment packages.
* Develop process and instrumentation diagrams (P\&IDs) applying COMOS for process gas, utility, and driver (Engine, Turbine, Electric Motor) systems.
* Develop and coordinate technical information from systems for consolidation into overall project documentation – utilities, cable lists, instrument setpoints etc.
* Conduct engineering calculations for the sizing and selection of systems components, such as heat exchangers, Scrubbers (KOD), control valves, safety valves, filters, accumulators, tanks, and pumps.
* Author technical specifications for purchase of auxiliary equipment and system modules.
* Own the internal layout and routings of systems for safety, maintainability, and operability.
* Aid the Project Lead Engineer (PLE) in engaging with both internal and external customers to run technical risks and identify potential opportunities.
* Participate in HAZOP and SIL studies to represent the applicable systems and nodes.
* Assist with production tasks within and outside the organization, which involves handling non\-conformances and reviewing material deviation requests.
* Supervise and own the packaging engineering schedule and budget, ensuring punctual completion of work.
* Provide support to bid management (BM) and front\-end engineering (FEE) to review and provide comments and exceptions to client specifications and to identify deviations from standards and to estimate commercial impacts if compliance is required.
* Provide systems engineering expertise and support to commissioning and field service.
* Conduct invention reviews on Packaging / systems engineering scope and attend project invention reviews.


**What You Bring**
* Minimum Education Level: Bachelor of Science or equivalent experience and proven experience. Specialization Field: Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering.
* Draft reciprocating compressor, project, and package engineering for turbo compressors, project packages, and assembly of synchronized packages.
* Knowledge of Industry Standards e.g. API\-618, API\-617, ISO\-13631 (or API11P), API 614, API\-610, API\-671 etc.
* Basic knowledge of Rotating equipment compressor/ Pumps \& other mechanical items, engineering calculations, interpretation of engineering drawings
* Reading and Preparation of Package Engineering drawings like P\&I Diagram, General Arrangement, Foundation Plan, piping plan and piping isometric drawings.
* Experience/ Exposure to work with \& interpretation of technical specifications of \- world\-class consultants like: EIL / TEIL / UHDE / LTC / Technip / Shell DEP / SAUDI ARAMCO / PDO etc.
* Knowledge \& exposure of international standards, codes like: ASME / ASTM / API / DIN / AWS, relevant to static equipment \& piping. Understanding of B31\.3 / B 31\.1 piping composition.
* Knowledge of production planning and schedule\-based environment

**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of output management solutions, including multifunction printers, secure print, label printers, and network printers.

* Experience in product management, business relationship management, roadmap planning, portfolio management, and agile delivery.
* Experience leading a team or workstream, motivating others, driving execution, and delivering results in a cross\-functional environment.
* Proven ability to develop information technology solutions that address complex business problems and enable measurable outcomes.
* Strong business partnership skills, including the ability to translate stakeholder needs into product priorities, technology requirements, and actionable plans.
* Experience coordinating with management, vendors, service providers, and technology partners to support delivery quality, service performance, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology governance, prioritization, change readiness, cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and service management practices.

description:

 lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. **A career that’s the whole package!**
 At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate, support for growth through individual and team development, and an environment where all voices can be heard.
   

  

**Conga** 
 crushes complexity within an increasingly complex world. **Our mission** 
 : Empower customers to deliver transformational revenue growth by aligning teams, processes, and technology to maximize customer lifetime value.
   

  

 Our approach is grounded in the Conga Way, a framework for what we stand for and everything we do as an organization — from hiring to decision making and product development. Developed with direct input from our colleagues, the Conga Way is the foundation for our culture.
   

  

**A quick snapshot** 
**…**
 A Senior Manager will build and manage an effective team from offshore centre. It includes hiring, training, coaching, retaining, and measuring the effectiveness of a high\-performing PS delivery team. Be a problem solver and a guide, coach, mentor, and a strong communicator.
   

  

**Why it’s a big deal…**
 The Senior Manager will play a key role in building a strong and effective team who will deal with different situations while working on the projects.
   

  

**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.** 
 Must have 15\+ years of experience in the IT industry, with strong experience in building and managing high\-performing teams. Should have solid experience coordinating with global and offshore teams, along with full lifecycle enterprise software implementation experience. Experience working with Conga products such as CPQ and CLM, or with any CRM or SaaS platform, will be a strong added advantage.
   

  

**Strong communication and interpersonal skills.** 
 You’re not just comfortable engaging in collaborative discussions, but initiating them, too. You are skilled at reading and adapting to different communication styles, and when you speak you are clear and concise. Your strong listening skills foster connection with our customers and stakeholders and allow you to accurately gather the right information so you can resolve issues in the most effective way.
   

  

**Natural collaborator.** 
 You work effectively across functions — with Delivery Teams, Practice Directors, Regional Heads and customer stakeholders — to drive successful project outcomes. You are proficient with Agile and have a collaborative, cross\-functional approach to delivering great solutions. You are comfortable working across multiple teams and championing best practices. You constantly seek opinions and solicit feedback to create the best work possible. You don’t know any other way, It’s a team effort and you completely appreciate that.
   

  

**People leadership and development.** 
 You take genuine ownership of your team — hiring, coaching, mentoring, and retaining top talent. You invest in each individual’s career growth and skill expansion, building clear development paths and a culture where people do their best work and want to stay.
   

  

**Driving initiatives and an AI\-first mindset.** 
 You lead organizational initiatives that raise the bar for delivery, and you champion AI\-driven ways of working to improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes. You proactively identify opportunities to innovate and bring your team along with you.
   

  

**Subject matter expertise.** 
 You serve as a trusted subject matter expert for Conga’s enterprise customers, understanding their business challenges and how our solutions solve them. You bring credibility to customer conversations and help your team navigate complex enterprise implementations.
   

  

**Education.** 
 A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field is highly preferred.
   

  

**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
**Passion** 
 . We know it when we see it. Passion is not about saying how much you love what you do in your most excited voice. Passion is revealed in your truest self. It’s about what you’ve accomplished; how you want to grow; the ideas you have; your philosophies. It’s demonstrating through your words and your actions that you truly believe in what you do \-\- and where you work. That it matters to you. And that’s pretty cool.
   

  

**Initiative** 
 . You don’t wait around for things to happen or for your manager to tell you what to do. You’re not only proactive about completing your own work, but when you sense the need to introduce a project that will benefit the team or the organization \-\- even if it’s outside your scope of work \-\- you put a proposal together, talk to the team about it, and
 *own it* 
 . And that also goes back to having an entrepreneurial spirt
   

  

**Did we pique your interest?**
 If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
   

  

**Preferred Resume Format**
 We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
   

  

**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?** 


 Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.
   

  

**Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement**
 The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (https://conga.com/applicant\-privacy\-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

title: Field Manager
description:
**Field Manager \- Ahmedabad GenAI Ready Naari Program** 




  





**Organization:** 
 Nimaya Foundation (https://www.nimaya.in/)
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad (mandatory)
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Field\-based (training centers across Ahmedabad); Full\-time
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time, fixed\-term (2\-year project; extension linked to program continuation)
 



**Reports To:** 
 Program Manager
 



**Apply By:** 
 10th August
 



  





**About Nimaya Foundation** 




 Nimaya is a
 **future\-ready not\-for\-profit cofounded in 2021 by Navya Nanda and Samyak Chakrabarty, focused on preparing young women facing socio\-economic barriers for a world of work being rapidly reshaped by AI and emerging technologies.** 




 As GenAI transforms industries, workflows and hiring expectations,
 **Nimaya works at the intersection of employability and AI readiness to ensure our Nimaya Naaris are not replaced by AI, but instead are equipped to participate and lead in this new economy** 
 .
 



 In partnership with institutions such as the
 **Government of India's IndiaAI Mission** 
 , we have
 **enabled 10,000\+ Nimaya Naaris across 5 states** 
 to step into the new world of work with our flagship program \- the GenAI Ready Naari.
 



  





**Learn more about our mission and the impact we create!** 



* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=D2q\-qB\-J1Dk
* https://www.ptinews.com/story/entertainment/navya\-nanda\-and\-samyak\-chakrabarty\-s\-nimaya\-partners\-with\-govt\-s\-ai\-mission/3249973
* https://mastersunion.org/blog/how\-navya\-nanda\-and\-samyak\-chakrabarty\-are\-changing\-lives\-with\-nimaya



  





**What's exciting about this role?** 




  





*Imagine leading the field charge for a program that can change the trajectory of a young naari's future in Ahmedabad by upskilling her in GenAI and 21st century workplace skills. We're building this program in partnership with Ashoka University's Centre for Social and Behaviour Change, to move the needle for young women from underserved communities and prepare them for the future of work.* 




  





 This is a hands\-on, on\-ground execution role. As a Field Manager, you will be present at training centers day to day, keep learner journeys on track, troubleshoot delivery issues in real time, and make sure every session runs smoothly.
 



  





**What does that mean for you?** 




  




* **Conduct regular center visits** 
 to track attendance and resolve on\-ground issues in real time
* **Onboard learners, verify documentation, and maintain accurate, batch\-wise records through our AI powered program management system**
* Coordinate and setup
 **mentoring sessions and live projects**
* Be the
 **first point of contact for trainers and venues** 
 : flag and fix delivery gaps on the spot
* **Support logistics for trainings and other interventions of the program** 
 : venue setup, learner mobilization, on\-ground troubleshooting
* **Escalate risks** 
 (attendance drops, trainer issues, compliance gaps) to the Program Manager promptly
* **Gather learner feedback and contribute ground\-level inputs to impact reporting**



  





**Nimaya's GenAI Ready Naari Program** 




  





 The GenAI Ready Naari Program equips young women with Generative AI skills and future\-ready workplace competencies through
 **40 hours of immersive, hands\-on learning** 
 , out of which 32 hours are offline training and 8 hours are online. In these sessions, Naaris explore:
 


* Building Chatbots \& training Agentic AIs
* AI\-powered research \& communication tactics
* Creative problem\-solving
* Presentation \& collaboration skills
* Real\-world projects \& mentorship



**The goal is not just to teach AI tools but to make learners truly future\-ready for what the modern workplace demands: the ability to confidently work with AI instead of feeling threatened by it.** 




  





**The Project you will join** 




 If selected, you will step into the role of
 **Field Manager of Nimaya's GenAI Ready Naari Program in Ahmedabad.** 
 Over the next 2 years, this project aims to:
 


* **Upskill 900 young women across Ahmedabad**
* Expand GenAI learning to
 **areas where access to AI exposure is still limited**
* Ensure
 **meaningful learner outcomes beyond certification**



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





***Mindset***



* Calm under pressure: able to improvise when a venue, trainer, or schedule changes at the last minute.
* Energised by being on the ground with learners every day, not managing from behind a screen.
* **Proactive Attitude:** 
 Willingness to take initiative and demonstrate adaptability.
* **Passion for Empowerment:** 
 A strong desire to support and enable the success of young women from restrictive circumstances.



  





**Background** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in
 **program operations, field execution, or project management roles**
* Experience in community mobilisation or working directly with young women learners is strongly preferred
* Strong proficiency in
 **Excel / Google Sheets / Claude for tracking and reporting**
* Familiarity with handling
 **compliance, documentation, and structured reporting systems**
* Strong communication skills in
 **English and Hindi; proficiency in Gujarati is essential**
* Comfortable with
 **daily travel between training centers within Ahmedabad** 
 (batches may run on weekends)
* Based in
 **Ahmedabad (mandatory)**



  





**How to Apply** 




 If you're a self\-motivated individual eager to contribute to a meaningful cause, we encourage you to apply. Please send your CV to contact@nimaya.in. Use the subject line "Application: Field Manager, Ahmedabad \- \[Your Name]" so we can track your application. 
 



  





 Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.
 



  





*﻿Join us at Nimaya and be part of a movement that's breaking barriers and building futures for young women with big dreams.*

+ Lead change management initiatives and ensure robust process validation for all new engineering implementations.
+ Responsible for idle asset management to optimize plant space and resource recovery.

+ Drive EHS initiatives to reduce Total Recordable Rate (TRR) and Days Away from Work (DAFW) rates, ensuring all regulatory permits and testing requirements are met.

* People \& Stakeholder Leadership
+ Foster productive partnerships with cross\-functional teams (Production, Procurement) and external vendors to enhance equipment performance.
+ Optimize team development through coaching, feedback, and managing with respect principles to build technical capability and engagement.

* Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience in engineering management, preferably within the FMCG or manufacturing sector.
* Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of plant floor systems (Wonderware), utilities maintenance, and capital project management.

title: US Tax Manager
description:
MYCPE ONE is building a modern, technology\-enabled accounting firm serving small and mid\-sized businesses across the United States. Our model combines experienced US client\-facing professionals with a highly skilled global delivery team to provide accounting, tax, audit, advisory, and CFO services.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Business Tax Delivery Lead** 
 to lead the execution and delivery of US business tax engagements from our India\-based global delivery team.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Business Tax Delivery Lead will be based in India and will serve as the operational and execution leader for MYCPE ONE's offshore Business Tax delivery team, supporting US business tax compliance and planning engagements end to end. This individual will oversee day\-to\-day engagement execution, manage the offshore business tax team, ensure technical quality and timely delivery, and work in close coordination with the US\-based Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.
 



 This is a full\-time, salaried leadership position within MYCPE ONE's global delivery organization. It does not carry responsibility for client acquisition or closing new CPA firm relationships. The focus is on operational excellence, execution, and delivery, working within engagements that the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead has already secured and scoped.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery Leadership** 



* Lead the offshore Business Tax delivery team supporting US\-based clients and CPA firms.
* Own end\-to\-end execution of assigned business tax compliance and planning engagements.
* Ensure returns and workpapers are staffed, scheduled, and delivered on time, particularly around federal and state filing deadlines and extension cycles.
* Implement and maintain SOPs, review checklists, and delivery workflows for business tax engagements.



  





**Engagement Execution and Client Servicing** 



* Serve as a direct point of contact for end clients on day\-to\-day business tax matters.
* Coordinate preparation of corporate (Form 1120\), S\-corporation (Form 1120\-S), and partnership (Form 1065\) returns, including multi\-state filings.
* Respond to client requests for information and resolve routine client queries, including estimated payments and notice\-related questions.
* Keep clients and the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead informed of engagement status and open items.



  





**Technical Review and Quality** 



* Review business tax returns, supporting workpapers, and calculations prepared by the offshore team.
* Apply and enforce IRS regulations, business tax compliance requirements, and firm methodology across engagements.
* Identify and resolve technical issues at the engagement level, escalating complex business tax planning, entity structuring, or controversy matters to the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.
* Support quality control reviews and consistency of review standards across the business tax team.



  





**Onshore Coordination** 



* Work closely with the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead on engagement planning and scoping handed off from the US side.
* Provide regular status updates, capacity forecasts, and escalation of risks or delays, particularly during peak filing season.
* Align offshore execution with onshore expectations on quality, timelines, and client communication standards.



  





**Team Management and Operations** 



* Manage, mentor, and develop offshore tax managers, seniors, and preparers focused on business tax.
* Plan resource allocation and workload distribution across engagements, especially during tax season peaks.
* Monitor engagement metrics such as turnaround time, review points, and rework.
* Drive process improvements and standardization across the business tax delivery team.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, and training of offshore business tax staff.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* CPA qualification (active US CPA license preferred) or Enrolled Agent (EA) credential; candidates with a completed CPA and strong US business tax experience will also be considered.
* Active PTIN (Preparer Tax Identification Number) in good standing with the IRS.
* 12\+ years of experience in US business tax compliance, with a primary focus on corporate, S\-corporation, and partnership return preparation and review.
* Experience working within an offshore or global delivery team serving US CPA firms or US clients directly.
* Demonstrated experience managing execution and delivery of business tax engagements, not limited to preparation or review of individual returns.
* Experience serving as a point of contact for end clients on business tax matters.
* Experience working in close coordination with an onshore or US\-based engagement lead or partner.
* Strong understanding of:
* Corporate, S\-corporation, and partnership tax compliance, including multi\-state filings
* Business tax planning, including entity structuring considerations
* K\-1 preparation and pass\-through reporting
* IRS notices, correspondence, and basic resolution processes
* Experience supervising and developing business tax teams.



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience in a role dedicated to delivery and operations rather than business development.
* Experience with outsourced or offshored business tax compliance services.
* Experience with multi\-entity or consolidated business tax structures.
* Experience with international information reporting related to US business tax filings.
* Experience with technology\-enabled business tax preparation and workflow tools.



  





**Technical Skills** 




 Experience with one or more of the following:
 


* Thomson Reuters (UltraTax)
* CCH Axcess / ProSystem fx Tax
* Drake
* Lacerte
* Intuit ProConnect



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within the first year, the Business Tax Delivery Lead will:
 


* Establish a reliable, well\-run offshore delivery model for US business tax engagements.
* Consistently meet filing deadlines and quality benchmarks, including through peak tax season.
* Build a strong, capable offshore business tax team.
* Operate as a trusted operational counterpart to the Onshore Tax Engagement Lead.
* Maintain high client satisfaction on execution and responsiveness.
* Drive measurable improvements in delivery efficiency and process consistency.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands\-on business tax professional based in India who has spent their career executing and managing US business tax engagements within an offshore or global delivery environment. They are comfortable working directly with US end clients on delivery matters, thrive in a structured operational role, and are motivated by running a high\-quality, efficient delivery engine rather than by business development or practice ownership.

title: Supplier Development Professional – Specialist
description:
**About Milacron**
 We serve the primary market segment: Milacron Injection, Molding \& Extrusion (MIME), which designs, manufactures, and sells injection and extrusion equipment, co\-injection systems and related parts and services.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 The Milacron Supplier Development group, a global and progressive function within Milacron, is currently seeking strong, results\-oriented candidates for the positions as a Supplier Quality Professional ranging from Specialist to Engineer.
   

  

 Reporting to Global Supplier Development, this position will support, facilitate, and lead Supplier Development actions for multiple regional facilities. The role focuses on supply chain performance with responsibility for supplier quality, assessing supplier capability, verifying the quality of purchased items at the source, providing timely and accurate supplier performance metrics, facilitating continuous improvement and training of the supporting supply base. In this role you will manage the resolution of supplier quality issues at the regional facilities as well as global suppliers for specific categories.
   

  

 As part of the Supplier Development organization, you will provide technical guidance in the use of quality management tools incorporating the technical disciplines found in FAI, PPAP, SPC, FMEA, Control Plans and Problem Analysis. Coordinate formal supplier training to drive consistency in process, including supplier continuous improvement and development programs. Work with underperforming suppliers to improve On\-time Delivery (OTD) and non\-conformance rates using improvement tools like 8Ds, A3’s, etc. Review and maintain evaluations of perspective suppliers and existing supplier performance, report status of supplier performance, and proactively act when quality trends indicate such action is warranted. Serve as liaison between engineering, procurement, quality and production to assure quality and reliability from the supply base. In addition, you will help build and sustain a strategic supply base that aligns with the corporate category management team strategy.
   

  

**General Characteristics**
***To perform this job successfully, the candidate will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform the essential duties proficiently.***
* Process and results driven with strong project management skills
* Have functional working knowledge of Quality Engineering principles
* Be a self\-starter with a proven ability to manage supplier improvement initiatives
* Strategically lead supplier performance improvement projects to increase the supplier capability of consistently meeting Milacron requirements
* Must be able to establish cross functional relationships and partnerships through your product and process knowledge
* Implement and monitor the part qualification and certification process with elected suppliers
* Champion problem solving and root cause analysis activities with suppliers and customers to eliminate recurrence of non\-conformances
* Function as liaison between procurement, engineering, manufacturing and suppliers to resolve supplier quality issues and to provide technical support
* Work to resolve supplier technical issues in a timely manner to ensure continuity of supply
* Support leadership and maintain a high level of performance in carrying out the goals of the department and corporation
* Review targeted supplier manufacturing processes, evaluate supplier root cause corrective actions relative to those processes and confirm identified failure modes.
* Ability to travel (up to 50%) is required


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Supplier Development, Manufacturing Quality or Supplier Quality Engineering in a manufacturing environment or Comparable Work Experience
* Understanding of Print Reading and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD\&T)
* Experience in Casting, Machining and Machined Components is preferred
* Experience in facilitating change and working with cross functional teams including engineering and manufacturing
* Experience in a high mix low volume global business is desired
* Familiarity in auditing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems
* Familiarity with US and International Industry measurement standards and tools
* Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and compliance auditing experience
* Experience in using structured problem solving to drive acute and chronic quality issues to closure


**Education**
* B.E/B. Tech degree from an accredited 4\-year college or university in a technical or supply chain related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Shop Operations, Materials or Sourcing
* Proficient oral and written communication skills
* Proficient in English language (verbal and written communications).


**Who We Are**
 Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900\+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end\-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US\-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.
   

  

**Eeo**
 The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron.com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

* 7\-10 yrs. of relevant experience in Manufacturing Engg.

 **Supriya.Joshi@skf.com**

 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment.  the makerspace, manage a multi\-disciplinary team of mentors, and deliver a curriculum that 
 



 connects coding, electronics, AI, and robotics to classroom learning. You are the main link 
 



 between TIS and the school, and you are accountable for the quality, outcomes, and growth of 
 



 the programme.

**Programme leadership** 




 ● Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery of the school innovation programme across Grades 1 to 10\. 
 



 ● Scale the makerspace, including layout, tools, safety systems, inventory, and daily operations. 
 



 ● Plan the academic year: term plans, timetables, events, and milestones aligned with the school calendar. 
 



 ● Define success metrics and track progress against them. 
 



**Team management** 




 ● Lead and mentor a team of program mentors across three strands: Makerspace, ICT/AI Curriculum, and
 **Robotics/Competitions.** 
  
 



 ● Assign responsibilities, set clear expectations for shifts and deliverables, and maintain workload balance. 
 



 ● Run regular team check\-ins, give constructive feedback, and support professional growth. 
 



 ● Coordinate with HR on hiring, onboarding, interns, and replacements to keep the team fully staffed. 
 



**Curriculum and academic alignment** 




 ● Oversee design and refinement of the ICT/AI and makerspace curriculum, including lesson plans, project guides, and assessments. 
 



 ● Ensure programme content fits the IB PYP and MYP frameworks and supports inquiry\-based, project\-led learning. 
 



 ● Work with school coordinators and teachers to integrate the programme with classroom units. 
 



**Robotics and competitions** 




 ● Oversee student participation in robotics and technology competitions such as VEX, FRC, FTC, and NRL. 
 



 ● Manage team formation, mentor allocation, registrations, budgets and event logistics. 
 



**Events and student showcases** 
  
 



 ● Plan and deliver school\-wide events such as MakerFest, exhibitions, visits and workshops. 
 



 ● Support Student\-Led Conferences by preparing the makerspace and student projects. 
 



**Stakeholder and partner management** 




 ● Act as the primary point of contact for school leadership, coordinators, and the founder's office. 
 



 ● Prepare regular reports, presentations, and updates for school and TIS leadership. 
 



 ● Build and manage partnerships with universities, industry, and ecosystem organisations for outreach, venues, and knowledge sharing. 
 



**Operations, budget, and reporting** 




 ● Plan and manage programme budgets, procurement, vendors, and equipment. 
 



 ● Maintain documentation, dashboards, and records of student progress, projects, and outcomes. 
 



 ● Identify risks early and resolve issues across people, resources, and timelines. 
 



**Required Qualifications and Skills** 




 ● Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Education, Technology, or a related field (Master's preferred). 
 



 ● 4\-6 years of experience in programme or project management, ideally in education, edtech, or
 **STEM/innovation.** 




 ● Proven experience leading and mentoring a team. 
 



 ● Working knowledge of robotics, electronics, coding, or makerspace environments. 
 



 ● Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including with school leadership and external partners. 
 



 ● Excellent planning, organisation, and problem\-solving abilities. 
 



**Good to Have** 




 ● Familiarity with IB PYP/MYP or other inquiry\-based curricula. 
 



 ● Experience running robotics competitions or student showcase events. 
 



 ● Experience setting up a makerspace, fab lab, or innovation lab. 
 



 ● Basic knowledge of AI/ML education for school students. 
 



 ● Experience with budgeting, vendor management, and impact reporting. 
 



**What We're Looking For** 




 ● A hands\-on leader who is equally comfortable in the makerspace and in a stakeholder meeting. 
 



 ● A builder who can take a programme from the ground up and make it sustainable 
 



 ● Someone who supports and develops their team while holding a high bar for delivery 
 



 ● A calm, organised communicator who handles competing priorities well

With a strong presence in both operational and under\-construction projects, AESL manages over 20,000 circuit kilometers of transmission lines and substations. As a part of the Adani Group, AESL is driven by the philosophy of \#GrowthWithGoodness, aiming to build a sustainable and resilient energy future.  • Develop and deploy the Systems Engineering operating model across product development programs.

 • Lead interface management between hardware, software, firmware, mechanical, electrical, clinical and quality functions.

 • Drive Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) adoption where applicable.
 



 • Build capability in risk\-driven system design and product safety engineering.
 



 • Recruit, mentor and develop systems engineers and technical leads.
 



 • Collaborate with Regulatory, Quality and Clinical teams for compliant product development.
 



**People Leadership Responsibilities** 




 • Build and lead a high\-performing Systems Engineering team.
 



 • Establish competency frameworks, mentoring programs and technical career paths.
 



 • Drive engineering excellence, design rigor and knowledge management.
 



 • Foster strong collaboration across global and cross\-functional teams.
 



**Required Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, Biomedical, Mechanical, Software Engineering or related discipline.
 



 • 12\+ years of engineering experience with significant medical device product development exposure.
 



 • 5\+ years leading technical teams, architecture teams or systems engineering functions.
 



 • Demonstrated experience delivering complex integrated hardware and software products.
 



**Technical Expertise** 




 • Systems Architecture and Product Architecture Development.
 



 • Requirements Engineering and Traceability Management.
 



 • Hardware\-Software Systems Integration.
 



 • Design Trade\-off Analysis and System Modeling.
 



 • Verification \& Validation Planning.
 



 • Reliability, Safety and Risk\-Based Design.
 



 • Root Cause Analysis and Problem Solving.
 



 • Product Lifecycle Management and Configuration Management.
 



 • MBSE tools and architecture modeling methodologies preferred.
 



**MedTech \& Compliance Knowledge** 




 Strong understanding of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601 family, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, CDSCO regulations, FDA Quality System Regulations/QMSR, EU MDR and design control expectations. Experience integrating systems engineering deliverables with Design Controls, DHF and regulatory submissions.
 



**Preferred Certifications**

 • Systems Engineering or Architecture Certifications.
 



 • ISO 13485 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor Certification.

 • Project Management and Agile Product Development Certifications.
 



**Core Competencies** 




 Systems Thinking, Architecture Leadership, Technical Depth, Innovation, Stakeholder Management, Product Safety, Team Development, Strategic Planning, Technical Decision Making, Communication and Influencing.
 



**Success Measures** 




 Successful establishment of Systems Engineering capability; scalable systems architecture practices; robust requirements traceability; reduced integration issues; successful product launches; strong engineering team growth; improved system quality, safety and regulatory readiness.

**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You hold many threads at once without dropping any of them
* You follow up firmly and politely — you don't let things go quiet

* You're discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information

* A high\-trust, high\-visibility seat next to leadership

* Room to grow into broader operations responsibility over time
